desc_es: Extensión de Joomla - regularlabs.com - Manejo inseguro de rutas en CDN para la extensión Joomla Pro - El versionado de CDN podría verificar rutas de archivos fuera del directorio del sitio, exponiendo la existencia de archivos locales y metadatos de modificación.

desc: Joomla Extension - regularlabs.com - Insecure path handling in Modals Pro extension - Modals gallery paths could enumerate unintended directories.
desc_es: Extensión de Joomla - regularlabs.com - Manejo inseguro de rutas en la extensión Modals Pro - Las rutas de la galería de Modals podrían enumerar directorios no deseados.

desc: The Tickera – Sell Tickets & Manage Events plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'tc_event_filter' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.0.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with staff-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The vulnerable code path is reachable by users holding the plugin's custom Staff role, as the plugin's add_required_capabilities() function grants that role the edit_tc_tickets_instances capability, providing access to the tc_tickets_instances admin list screen where the filter is applied.

The WP Encryption – One Click Free SSL Certificate & SSL / HTTPS Redirect, Security & SSL Scan plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.6.6 via the 'imploded' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Although file write content is passed through esc_html(), which encodes angle brackets and prevents direct PHP execution, plaintext configuration files such as .htaccess are fully writable and exploitable for denial-of-service or redirect attacks. This is only exploitable when the premium version of the software is enabled and active.

The Grid/List View for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'position' Shortcode Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The shortcode's all_page="1" attribute can be used to force the widget to render on any page, expanding the attack surface beyond shop and category pages.

The GutenKit Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of data due to a missing capability check on the /wp-json/gutenkit/v1/mailchimp/get/lists and /wp-json/gutenkit/v1/mailchimp/get/interests REST API endpoints in versions up to, and including, 2.4.12. Both endpoints are registered with permission_callback => '__return_true', and their callbacks read the site's stored Mailchimp API key from the gutenkit_settings_list option and proxy Mailchimp audience/list, merge-field, interest-category, interest-name, and subscriber-count metadata back to the caller with no login, nonce, or capability check. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to retrieve private Mailchimp audience configuration information from any site that has configured the GutenKit Mailchimp integration.

The Premium Packages – Sell Digital Products Securely plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'orderby' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.4 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with admin-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The WCPOS – Point of Sale (POS) plugin for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.8 via the 'type' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with shop manager-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Successful exploitation requires supplying context=edit in the request, which bypasses the content-stripping logic in prepare_item_for_response() and returns the traversed file verbatim in the REST API response.

Joomla Extension - regularlabs.com - SSRF via remote image downloads in Articles Anywhere and Users Anywhere extensions - Content-controlled image URLs could request private or reserved network services, follow unsafe redirects and save responses without validating that they were images. This could result in SSRF, internal-data access or writing attacker-controlled files into a web-accessible folder.
desc_es: Extensión de Joomla - regularlabs.com - SSRF a través de descargas remotas de imágenes en las extensiones Articles Anywhere y Users Anywhere - Las URLs de imágenes controladas por el contenido podrían solicitar servicios de red privados o reservados, seguir redirecciones inseguras y guardar respuestas sin validar que fueran imágenes. Esto podría resultar en SSRF, acceso a datos internos o la escritura de archivos controlados por el atacante en una carpeta accesible por la web.

desc: Joomla Extension - regularlabs.com - Inconsistent CSRF token checks / privilege checks in Cache Cleaner extension - Administrator URL purges did not consistently require a valid token and cache-management permission.
desc_es: Extensión de Joomla - regularlabs.com - Comprobaciones inconsistentes de token CSRF / comprobaciones de privilegios en la extensión Cache Cleaner - Las purgas de URL de administrador no requerían consistentemente un token válido y permiso de gestión de caché.

desc: The MountDev AI MCP Connector for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.1. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to obtain an administrator-bound OAuth Bearer token via a self-registered client, granting full administrator-equivalent access to the plugin's MCP tool surface and all exposed WordPress content, users, and options. This is exploitable by combining the publicly accessible Dynamic Client Registration endpoint, which allows unauthenticated callers to register arbitrary OAuth clients with an attacker-controlled redirect_uri, with the unprotected authorization endpoint to complete the full OAuth flow without any administrator interaction.

The MDJM Event Management plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.8.4. This is due to missing capability checks and nonce verification in the `MDJM_Permissions::set_permissions()` and `MDJM_Employee_Manager::init()` functions, combined with the absence of server-side allow-list validation on the `employee_roles[]` and `new_role` POST parameters before they are passed to `mdjm_set_employee_role()` and `WP_User::set_role()`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to grant arbitrary MDJM capabilities — including `mdjm_employee` and `mdjm_employee_edit` — to any registered WordPress role, and subsequently leverage a subscriber-level account to escalate privileges to Administrator. `MDJM_Permissions::init()` is registered on the public WordPress `init` hook without any authentication gate, meaning the role-manipulation endpoint is reachable without any prior login.

The Premium Packages – Sell Digital Products Securely plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.4 via the `wpdmppdl` parameter. This is due to the `download()` function — hooked to the unauthenticated WordPress `wp` action — decoding the attacker-controlled `wpdmppdl` parameter using only `base64_decode()` and `json_decode()` with no HMAC, cryptographic signature, or nonce verification, and then issuing WordPress authentication cookies after a domain check that is trivially bypassed because both sides of the comparison are attacker-supplied values. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as any non-administrator WordPress user, including subscribers, customers, contributors, authors, editors, and shop managers, who owns an order, gaining full session-level access to that account.

The Header Footer Script Adder – Insert Code in Header, Body & Footer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'asm_code' Snippet Meta in all versions up to, and including, 2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The Lpagery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via post titles in versions up to, and including, 2.5.7. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping in the lpagery_add_filter_text_template_post() function, which is hooked to admin_footer and echoes the raw post_title of the post referenced by the ?lpagery_template query parameter directly inside a JavaScript single-quoted string literal, without esc_js(), esc_html(), or any other encoding. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a higher-privileged user (such as an administrator) accesses an admin page with the ?lpagery_template=<post_id> parameter pointing at the attacker's post.

The Tickera – Sell Tickets & Manage Events plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'tc_order_status_filter' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.0.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with staff-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The Brands for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'style' Shortcode Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 3.8.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The Brands for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'br_brand_tooltip' Term Meta Field in all versions up to, and including, 3.8.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Because the payload is stored in term meta rather than post content, the WordPress unfiltered_html capability exception does not apply, meaning Shop Manager-level users — who normally lack unfiltered_html — can fully exploit this vulnerability.

The Registrations For The Events Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via JSON keys in the 'standard' parameter handled by the rtec_records_edit AJAX action in versions up to and including 3.2. The handler decodes attacker-controlled JSON from $_POST['standard'] and uses the JSON array keys directly as column identifiers in the SET clause of an UPDATE statement built inside RTEC_Db_Admin::update_entry(). Only esc_sql() (mysqli_real_escape_string) is applied to the identifier; that function escapes quotes, backslashes, and a few control characters but does not escape spaces, equals signs, parentheses, or hyphens, so an attacker can break out of the identifier context and inject subqueries (terminated with a SQL comment). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above who can edit the targeted event, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The GoDAM – Organize WordPress Media Library & File Manager with Unlimited Folders for Images, Videos & more plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file uploads in versions up to, and including, 1.12.2. This is due to insufficient file type validation in the save_video_file() function hooked into WPForms' public wpforms_process_before_filter, which trusts the attacker-supplied multipart Content-Type header, preserves the original filename via wp_unique_filename(), and moves the raw upload with $wp_filesystem->move() into a web-served directory — bypassing wp_handle_upload()'s MIME/extension allowlist. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files on the affected site's server which may make remote code execution possible.

The Equalize Digital Accessibility Checker – WCAG, ADA, EAA and Section 508 compliance plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'html' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.46.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the attacker to have the ability to edit a post, as the REST endpoint /accessibility-checker/v1/post-scan-results/{id} is guarded only by the edit_post capability on the target post.

The Customer Support Ticket System & Helpdesk plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Code Injection via the 'path' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.5 due to the use of dynamic function invocation on an attacker-controlled value with insufficient validation. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to invoke arbitrary parameterless PHP functions, which can be used to disrupt site functionality or expose sensitive information. The required nonce is publicly emitted via wp_localize_script whenever the plugin's [emd_form] shortcode is rendered on any public-facing page, making the endpoint reachable by unauthenticated visitors without any prior authentication or privilege.

The AI Copilot – Content Generator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via 'order[0][dir]' Parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The required waic-nonce is emitted on the front-end whenever the [waic_form] or [aiwu-form] shortcode is rendered, enabling contributor-level users who can publish shortcodes to obtain a valid nonce and reach the vulnerable AJAX handler, which performs no capability check beyond nonce verification when the shortcodes are not already embedded in a page.
RRSIGs with too few labels can lead to bypass of DNSSEC wildcard validation
desc_es: RRSIGs con muy pocas etiquetas puede llevar a la omisión de la validación de comodines DNSSEC

desc: Information disclosure in Bosch Configuration Manager in Version 7.72.0106 allows an attacker to access sensitive information.
desc_es: Revelación de información en Bosch Configuration Manager en la Versión 7.72.0106 permite a un atacante acceder a información sensible.

desc: A missing authentication check in Bosch IP cameras of families CPP13 and CPP14 allows an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve video analytics event data.
desc_es: Una verificación de autenticación faltante en cámaras IP Bosch de las familias CPP13 y CPP14 permite a un atacante no autenticado recuperar datos de eventos de análisis de video.

desc:
Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in TUBITAK BILGEM Software Technologies Research Institute pardus-update allows OS Command Injection.

This issue affects pardus-update: from 0.6.6 before 0.7.0.
desc_es:
Vulnerabilidad de neutralización incorrecta de elementos especiales utilizados en un comando del SO (’inyección de comandos del SO’) en TUBITAK BILGEM Software Technologies Research Institute pardus-update permite la inyección de comandos del SO.

Este problema afecta a pardus-update: desde 0.6.6 antes de 0.7.0.

desc: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in fastjson 1.2.68 through 1.2.83. This vulnerability is exploitable under fastjson's stock default configuration — no AutoType enablement required, no classpath gadget required.
desc_es: Una vulnerabilidad de ejecución remota de código (RCE) existe en fastjson desde 1.2.68 hasta 1.2.83. Esta vulnerabilidad es explotable bajo la configuración predeterminada de fábrica de fastjson - no se requiere la habilitación de AutoType, no se requiere un gadget de classpath.

desc:
If the auth responds very slowly and the records expire in between, the capping of TTLs is not enforced for lack of data. This does not happen on regular resolve as then then the 
child records are used immediately if not expired and thus valid, or the
 records are expired, and in that case not used.  So this case 
can only happen if almost expired records are used to refresh the 
authoritative NS records.
desc_es: Si la autoridad responde muy lentamente y los registros expiran en el interín, la limitación de los TTL no se aplica por falta de datos. Esto no sucede en la resolución regular, ya que entonces los registros hijo se utilizan inmediatamente si no han expirado y, por lo tanto, son válidos, o los registros han expirado, y en ese caso no se utilizan. Así que este caso solo puede ocurrir si se utilizan registros casi expirados para actualizar los registros NS autoritativos.

desc: The issue is a DNSSEC validation bypass where wildcard expansion proofs (NSEC/NSEC3 records) are accepted without signature validation when the wildcard answer is a CNAME or DNAME record.
desc_es: El problema es una elusión de validación de DNSSEC donde las pruebas de expansión de comodín (registros NSEC/NSEC3) son aceptadas sin validación de firma cuando la respuesta de comodín es un registro CNAME o DNAME.

desc:
An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Linux-Gaming PortProtonQt allows any users to mount and unmount arbitrary file systems and modify the network configuration via NetworkManager.






This issue affects PortProtonQt before 0d0f0950ebd948cdf82e8c3e1ebd2bcb9b8bafbe.
desc_es:
Una vulnerabilidad de autorización incorrecta en Linux-Gaming PortProtonQt permite a cualquier usuario montar y desmontar sistemas de archivos arbitrarios y modificar la configuración de red a través de NetworkManager.

Este problema afecta a PortProtonQt antes de 0d0f0950ebd948cdf82e8c3e1ebd2bcb9b8bafbe.

desc: The WP Shortcode by MyThemeShop plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'title' parameter of the [tab] shortcode in versions up to, and including, 1.4.17. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping in the mts_tabs() function, which outputs the title shortcode attribute directly into the HTML output between anchor tags without applying any escaping functions. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The Lumise Product Designer for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the 'id' and 'table' parameters in the uploaded cart JSON file processed by the checkout AJAX action in versions up to, and including, 2.1.1. This is due to insufficient escaping on the user-supplied parameters before they are appended directly to a raw SQL query in the find_resource() function — the 'id' field is interpolated without quotes into a WHERE clause (numeric context) and 'table' is interpolated into the FROM clause, neither of which is protected by wp_magic_quotes or passed through $wpdb->prepare(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The Webpushr Push Notifications plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'webpushr_notification_title' and 'webpushr_notification_body' parameters in versions up to, and including, 4.39.0. This is due to insufficient input sanitization in the save_send_notification_flag() function and missing output escaping in the wpp_notification_box() function, which concatenates raw post meta values directly into HTML attribute and textarea contexts. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

A Missing Authorization vulnerability in selinux policycoreutils seunshares allows a user that is running in unconfined context to kill e.g. root-owned processes running also in
unconfined context






This issue affects policycoreutils through 3.10.
desc_es:
Una vulnerabilidad de falta de autorización en selinux policycoreutils seunshares permite a un usuario que se ejecuta en un contexto no confinado matar, p. ej., procesos propiedad de root que también se ejecutan en un contexto no confinado.

Este problema afecta a policycoreutils hasta 3.10.

desc: The ARforms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'password' Field Values in all versions up to, and including, 7.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The security-ninja-premium WordPress plugin before 5.290 does not verify the second authentication factor in one of its two-factor authentication code paths, allowing an unauthenticated attacker who knows a user's password to complete authentication without the one-time code and bypass enforced two-factor authentication for any account, including administrators. The affected two-factor module ships only in the premium build.

A Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition vulnerability in seunshare of selinux policycoreutils allows a user calling seunshare that is running in the unconfined SELinux domain to delete arbitrary root-owned files,






This issue affects policycoreutils through 3.10.
desc_es:
Una vulnerabilidad de condición de carrera de tipo Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) en seunshare de selinux policycoreutils permite a un usuario que llama a seunshare, que se ejecuta en el dominio SELinux no confinado, eliminar archivos arbitrarios propiedad de root.

Este problema afecta a policycoreutils hasta la versión 3.10.

desc: The WP Compress  WordPress plugin before 7.10.04 does not validate the value of a query parameter that controls the asset CDN host before using it to build the URLs of JavaScript files emitted on the page, leading to Reflected XSS. When a visitor follows a crafted link, the WP Compress  WordPress plugin before 7.10.04's loader injects script elements pointing to an attacker-controlled origin, which lets the attacker execute arbitrary JavaScript in the visitor's session on the target site.

The Post Status Notifier Lite WordPress plugin before 1.13.0 does not properly escape the `mod` URL parameter before reflecting it into the admin settings page (`admin.php?page=post-status-notifier-lite`), leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability that fires in the administrator's session when they are tricked into following a crafted URL.

The Praison AI SEO WordPress plugin before 5.0.7 does not perform authorization checks on several of its REST API routes, allowing unauthenticated users to modify the permalink of any published post and to read Praison AI SEO WordPress plugin before 5.0.7 configuration data.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfs: resample the data fork mapping after cycling ILOCK

xfs_reflink_fill_{cow_hole,delalloc} are both presented with an inode,
a data fork mapping, and a cow fork mapping.  Unfortunately, these two
helpers cycle the ILOCK to grab a transaction, which means that the
mappings are stale as soon as we reacquire the ILOCK.  Currently we
refresh the cow fork mapping by re-calling xfs_find_trim_cow_extent, but
we don't refresh the data fork mapping beforehand, which means that the
xfs_bmap_trim_cow in that function queries the refcount btree about the
wrong physical blocks and returns an inaccurate value in *shared.

If *shared is now false, the directio write proceeds with a stale data
fork mapping.  Fix this by querying the data fork mapping if the
sequence counter changes across the ILOCK cycle.

The FormCraft plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '[parameter name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.14 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit chain combines a server-side gap — where composite matrix sub-field keys such as field2_0 and field2_1 are never passed through the sanitization loop and are stored raw via $wpdb->insert() — with a client-side gap where DOMPurify is only invoked when typeof field.value === 'string', but matrix values arrive from the server as arrays, bypassing the check before being mapped to strings and injected into the DOM. Additionally, the same sink is reachable via a second attack vector: array-typed field values are passed through htmlentities() on submission but later reversed by html_entity_decode() at formcraft-main.php:2608 and :2122, restoring the malicious payload before storage and rendering.

The SUMO Reward Points plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the REST API endpoint `/wp-json/wc-srp/v1/earning` in versions up to, and including, 32.7.0. This is due to the `user_has_cap` filter in the `SRP_REST_Earning_Controller` class unconditionally granting the custom `rs_earning_read` capability to all users — including unauthenticated visitors — combined with missing sanitization of the `reason` parameter in the `create_items()` function and missing output escaping in the `column_default()` method of `SRP_Master_Log`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts into the reward points log that will execute whenever an administrator accesses the Master Log or User Reward Points admin pages.

Printers and Multifunction Printers (MFPs) provided by Ricoh Company, Ltd. do not implement restrictions on SSH port forwarding, allowing to connect to arbitrary destinations. When SSH is enabled on an affected product, SSH port forwarding may be leveraged to connect to other node on the LAN.
desc_es: Las impresoras y dispositivos multifunción (MFP) proporcionados por Ricoh Company, Ltd. no implementan restricciones en el reenvío de puertos SSH, lo que permite la conexión a destinos arbitrarios. Cuando SSH está habilitado en un producto afectado, el reenvío de puertos SSH puede ser aprovechado para conectarse a otro nodo en la LAN.

desc: A flaw was found in GNU nano's multi-buffer error message handling. When a user opens multiple files at startup and one triggers an ALERT-level error, a specially crafted filename containing printf format specifiers can be reinterpreted. This format string vulnerability may allow an attacker to achieve stack information disclosure, cause a denial of service (crash), or potentially perform arbitrary memory writes.

@fastify/static evaluates the allowedPath callback before normalizing dot segments and duplicate path separators in the pathname used for file resolution. Versions up to and including 10.1.1 are affected. An unauthenticated attacker can bypass allowedPath restrictions by requesting equivalent non-canonical pathnames, causing files that were intended to be denied to be served anyway. The bypass does not allow access outside the configured static root by itself, it defeats path-based filtering only. The issue is patched in @fastify/static 10.1.2.

@fastify/static up to and including version 10.1.0 fails to reject dot-dot path segments in request pathnames before the file-resolution stage. This is a bypass of the earlier fix for CVE-2026-6414, which only covered encoded forward slashes. Because the underlying send library normalizes dot segments before applying its own path-traversal guard, an unauthenticated attacker can bypass any route-scoped middleware and read files inside the static root that live under the guarded URL prefix. The bypass does not allow access outside the configured static root by itself, it defeats route-guard filtering only. The issue is patched in @fastify/static 10.1.1.

The alertmanager templates test endpoint (/api/alertmanager/grafana/config/api/v1/templates/test) can execute templates with no memory limits. Mass-executing templates in a short period causes OOM and crashes the Grafana service. The endpoint requires very low privileges and is exploitable with anonymous access enabled.
desc_es: El endpoint de prueba de plantillas de alertmanager (/API/alertmanager/grafana/config/API/v1/templates/test) puede ejecutar plantillas sin límites de memoria. La ejecución masiva de plantillas en un corto período provoca OOM y la caída del servicio de Grafana. El endpoint requiere privilegios muy bajos y es explotable con el acceso anónimo habilitado.

desc: A security flaw has been discovered in boazsegev facil.io up to 0.7.58. This affects the function http_sendfile2 of the file lib/facil/http/http.c of the component Public Folder Handler. Performing a manipulation results in path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
desc_es: Se ha descubierto una falla de seguridad en boazsegev facil.io hasta la versión 0.7.58. Esto afecta a la función http_sendfile2 del archivo lib/facil/http/http.c del componente Gestor de Carpeta Pública. Realizar una manipulación resulta en salto de ruta. Es posible la explotación remota del ataque. El exploit ha sido publicado y puede ser utilizado para ataques. El proyecto fue informado del problema con antelación a través de un informe de incidencias, pero aún no ha respondido.

desc: A flaw has been found in boazsegev facil.io up to 0.7.4. Affected is the function websocket_on_protocol_error in the library lib/facil/http/parsers/websocket_parser.h of the component WebSocket Frame Parser. This manipulation of the argument on_message causes improper input validation. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
desc_es: Se ha encontrado una falla en boazsegev facil.io hasta 0.7.4. La función afectada es websocket_on_protocol_error en la biblioteca lib/facil/http/parsers/websocket_parser.h del componente WebSocket Frame Parser. Esta manipulación del argumento on_message causa una validación de entrada incorrecta. El ataque puede iniciarse de forma remota. El exploit ha sido publicado y puede ser utilizado. Se informó al proyecto del problema con antelación a través de un informe de incidencias, pero aún no ha respondido.

desc: A vulnerability was detected in publint up to 0.1.4. This impacts the function child_process.exec of the file src/node/pack.js of the component package-manager Command Handler. The manipulation results in os command injection. Attacking locally is a requirement. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is identified as adf2d9a09945fc98c85a2520a89f441d78b2dbd8. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue. The project maintainer explains: "I think it's very rare for someone to use this package with untrusted input".

Vulnerability in the Oracle Platform Security for Java product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Centralized Thirdparty Jars).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Platform Security for Java.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle Platform Security for Java, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Platform Security for Java. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.9 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). desc:
OIDC::Lite versions through 0.12.1 for Perl allow ID Token signature verification bypass via a token-controlled algorithm allowlist in verify.

When the caller does not pin an algorithm, OIDC::Lite::Model::IDToken::verify sets $self->alg($self->header->{alg}) from the token's own header and then calls decode_jwt(token, key, 1, [$self->alg]), handing JSON::WebToken an accepted-algorithm allowlist taken from the untrusted token. A token with alg=none yields ['none'], so decode_jwt returns the claims with no signature check, and a token with alg=HS256 is verified with the RP's RSA public key as the HMAC secret (RS to HS confusion).

The ID Token is the OpenID Connect authentication assertion delivered to the Relying Party. Any caller that verifies an ID Token through the unpinned load(token)->verify path, or load(token, key) with only the key pinned, accepts a forged token carrying attacker-chosen claims such as sub and is authenticated as any user. Passing an explicit algorithm so $self->alg is already set bypasses the header-derived allowlist and is not affected.

Note that the latest version uploaded to CPAN is 0.10. Later versions are available in the git repository.
desc_es:
Las versiones de OIDC::Lite hasta la 0.12.1 para Perl permiten eludir la verificación de la firma del ID Token mediante una lista blanca de algoritmos controlada por el token en verify.

Cuando el llamador no fija un algoritmo, OIDC::Lite::Model::IDToken::verify establece $self  ->  alg($self  ->  header  ->  {alg}) desde la propia cabecera del token y luego llama a decode_jwt(token, key, 1, [$self  ->  alg]), entregando a JSON::WebToken una lista blanca de algoritmos aceptados tomada del token no confiable. Un token con alg=none produce [’none’], por lo que decode_jwt devuelve las ’claims’ sin verificación de firma, y un token con alg=HS256 se verifica con la clave pública RSA del RP como secreto HMAC (confusión de RS a HS).

El ID Token es la aserción de autenticación de OpenID Connect entregada a la parte confiable. Cualquier llamador que verifique un ID Token a través de la ruta no fijada load(token)  ->  verify, o load(token, key) con solo la clave fijada, acepta un token falsificado que contiene ’claims’ elegidas por el atacante, como ’sub’, y es autenticado como cualquier usuario. Pasar un algoritmo explícito de modo que $self  ->  alg ya esté establecido elude la lista blanca derivada de la cabecera y no se ve afectado.

Tenga en cuenta que la última versión subida a CPAN es la 0.10. Las versiones posteriores están disponibles en el repositorio git.

desc: An issue in OhSoft CoffeeZip v4.8.0.0 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via downloading and executing a crafted archive file.
desc_es: Un problema en OhSoft CoffeeZip v4.8.0.0 permite a los atacantes ejecutar código arbitrario mediante la descarga y ejecución de un archivo comprimido manipulado.

desc: An issue in Milos Paripovic OneCommander v.3.96.0.0 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the OneCommander.exe component.
desc_es: Un problema en Milos Paripovic OneCommander v.3.96.0.0 permite a un atacante remoto ejecutar código arbitrario a través del componente OneCommander.exe.

desc: BandiZip v.7.37 is affected by a Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the Mark-of-the-Web protection mechanism on affected installations of BandiZip
desc_es: BandiZip v.7.37 está afectado por una vulnerabilidad de omisión de autenticación. Esta vulnerabilidad permite a atacantes remotos omitir el mecanismo de protección Mark-of-the-Web en instalaciones afectadas de BandiZip.

desc: An issue in Franco Corbelli ZPAQFRANZ v.61.3 and before allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code via a bypass of the Mark-of-the-Web protection mechanism
desc_es: Un problema en Franco Corbelli ZPAQFRANZ v.61.3 y versiones anteriores permite a un atacante remoto escalar privilegios y ejecutar código arbitrario mediante una omisión del mecanismo de protección Mark-of-the-Web.

desc: An issue in ConeXware, Inc Power Archiver v.22.00.11 and before allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code via the powerarc.exe.
desc_es: Un problema en ConeXware, Inc Power Archiver v.22.00.11 y versiones anteriores permite a un atacante remoto escalar privilegios y ejecutar código arbitrario a través del powerarc.exe.

desc: An issue in ZipGenius Team ZipGenius v.6.3.2.3116 and before allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code via the zipgenius.exe.
desc_es: Un problema en ZipGenius Team ZipGenius v.6.3.2.3116 y versiones anteriores permite a un atacante remoto escalar privilegios y ejecutar código arbitrario a través del zipgenius.exe.

desc: An issue in NCH Software ExpressZip v11.29 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via downloading and executing a crafted archive file.
desc_es: Un problema en NCH Software ExpressZip v11.29 permite a los atacantes ejecutar código arbitrario mediante la descarga y ejecución de un archivo comprimido manipulado.

desc: During query planning when reading the sort pattern in raw BSONObj form, in some places we don’t explicitly handle the meta expression case. This may lead to incorrect transformations leading to invariant failure.
desc_es: Durante la planificación de consultas, al leer el patrón de ordenación en formato BSONObj crudo, en algunos lugares no manejamos explícitamente el caso de la metaexpresión. Esto puede llevar a transformaciones incorrectas que resultan en un fallo de invariante.

desc: Question2Answer through 1.8.8 contains a session invalidation vulnerability that allows attackers with a previously obtained remember-me cookie to retain authenticated access by exploiting the forgot-password reset flow's failure to clear the sessioncode field in qa-include/app/users-edit.php. While the normal password-change flow in qa-include/pages/account.php explicitly clears the sessioncode to invalidate persistent qa_session cookies, the forgot-password handler qa_finish_reset_user() omits this step, allowing any valid persistent cookie issued before the reset to continue authenticating the account after the password reset completes.
desc_es: Question2Answer hasta la 1.8.8 contiene una vulnerabilidad de invalidación de sesión que permite a los atacantes con una cookie remember-me obtenida previamente retener el acceso autenticado al explotar el fallo del flujo de restablecimiento de contraseña olvidada para borrar el campo sessioncode en qa-include/app/users-edit.php. Mientras que el flujo normal de cambio de contraseña en qa-include/pages/account.php borra explícitamente el sessioncode para invalidar las cookies persistentes qa_session, el gestor de contraseña olvidada qa_finish_reset_user() omite este paso, permitiendo que cualquier cookie persistente válida emitida antes del restablecimiento continúe autenticando la cuenta después de que se complete el restablecimiento de la contraseña.

desc: When importing connections in Compass it is possible to override some connection options that are otherwise can't be changed via connection form. In particular it is possible to provide a custom browser open command for OIDC auth flow that is usually can be set only globally via Compass settings.
desc_es: Al importar conexiones en Compass es posible anular algunas opciones de conexión que de otro modo no se pueden cambiar a través del formulario de conexión. En particular, es posible proporcionar un comando de apertura de navegador personalizado para el flujo de autenticación OIDC que normalmente solo se puede configurar globalmente a través de la configuración de Compass.

desc: The code to parse MIME headers for display when forwarding a message (if the setting to view all headers was enabled) had an off-by-one error, allowing a single byte to be read from the memory after the buffer for the headers, and potentially crashing Thunderbird. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 153 and Thunderbird 140.13.
desc_es: El código para analizar encabezados MIME para mostrar al reenviar un mensaje (si la configuración para ver todos los encabezados estaba habilitada) tenía un error de off-by-one, permitiendo que se leyera un solo byte de la memoria después del búfer para los encabezados, y potencialmente bloqueando Thunderbird. Esta vulnerabilidad se corrigió en Thunderbird 153 y Thunderbird 140.13.

desc: An unauthenticated remote client can cause excessive CPU consumption on a MongoDB server by sending a specific combination of parameters to the awaitable hello command in exhaust mode. The server's handling of this combination results in a response loop that bypasses normal throttling, allowing a small number of connections to degrade server availability.
desc_es: Un cliente remoto no autenticado puede causar un consumo excesivo de CPU en un servidor MongoDB al enviar una combinación específica de parámetros al comando ’hello’ awaitable en modo ’exhaust’. El manejo por parte del servidor de esta combinación resulta en un bucle de respuesta que omite la limitación normal, permitiendo que un pequeño número de conexiones degrade la disponibilidad del servidor.

desc: An authenticated user can cause the mongod process to be terminated by the operating system under memory pressure via the $rankFusion and $scoreFusion aggregation stages. The issue originates in the server's error-handling path and requires the ability to run aggregation queries.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado puede causar que el proceso mongod sea terminado por el sistema operativo bajo presión de memoria a través de las etapas de agregación $rankFusion y $scoreFusion. El problema se origina en la ruta de manejo de errores del servidor y requiere la capacidad de ejecutar consultas de agregación.

desc: An authenticated user can cause a {{mongod}} process to be terminated by the operating system under memory pressure by performing a specific data type conversion operation within MongoDB's aggregation framework. The behavior stems from disproportionate memory consumption during this operation, and requires both write access to the database and the ability to run aggregation queries.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado puede provocar que un proceso {{mongod}} sea terminado por el sistema operativo bajo presión de memoria al realizar una operación específica de conversión de tipo de datos dentro del framework de agregación de MongoDB. El comportamiento se deriva de un consumo de memoria desproporcionado durante esta operación, y requiere tanto acceso de escritura a la base de datos como la capacidad de ejecutar consultas de agregación.

desc: A missing bounds check in the BSON CodeWScope element accessors allows an attacker to trigger an out-of-bounds heap read via a crafted aggregation pipeline. The vulnerability can be exploited by an authenticated user by generating a malformed BSONColumn data containing a CodeWScope element, bypassing wire-level BSON validation. When the forged element is decompressed, the unchecked size value is used in pointer arithmetic, causing either a server crash or disclosure of adjacent heap memory contents.
desc_es: Una comprobación de límites faltante en los accesores del elemento BSON CodeWScope permite a un atacante activar una lectura de pila fuera de límites a través de una pipeline de agregación manipulada. La vulnerabilidad puede ser explotada por un usuario autenticado generando datos BSONColumn malformados que contengan un elemento CodeWScope, eludiendo la validación BSON a nivel de cable. Cuando el elemento falsificado es descomprimido, el valor de tamaño no verificado se utiliza en aritmética de punteros, causando un fallo del servidor o la divulgación del contenido de la memoria de pila adyacente.

desc: A vulnerability was discovered in MongoDB Server where the server-side MozJS scripting engine unconditionally registered a module loading hook that enables JavaScript calls to read arbitrary files from the host filesystem using the mongod process's privileges. An authenticated user could exploit this through crafted aggregation pipeline commands to read sensitive files accessible to the MongoDB server process.
desc_es: Una vulnerabilidad fue descubierta en el servidor de MongoDB donde el motor de scripting MozJS del lado del servidor registró incondicionalmente un ’hook’ de carga de módulos que permite a las llamadas JavaScript leer archivos arbitrarios del sistema de archivos del host utilizando los privilegios del proceso mongod. Un usuario autenticado podría exploit esto a través de comandos de ’pipeline’ de agregación manipulados para leer archivos sensibles accesibles al proceso del servidor de MongoDB.

desc: An authenticated user holding cursor termination privileges on one database may incorrectly be permitted to terminate active cursors on a separate database, disrupting ongoing query operations for other users. The behavior stems from an authorization check that does not correctly scope privileges to the appropriate namespace.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado que posee privilegios de terminación de cursor en una base de datos puede permitírsele incorrectamente terminar cursores activos en una base de datos separada, interrumpiendo operaciones de consulta en curso para otros usuarios. El comportamiento se deriva de una comprobación de autorización que no delimita correctamente los privilegios al espacio de nombres apropiado.

desc: An authenticated user can cause excessive CPU consumption or out-of-memory conditions on a MongoDB server by sending a crafted Queryable Encryption find payload containing an unvalidated field used to control an internal computation loop. The resulting resource exhaustion degrades availability for other operations.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado puede causar consumo excesivo de CPU o condiciones de falta de memoria en un servidor MongoDB al enviar una carga útil ’find’ de Cifrado Consultable manipulada que contiene un campo no validado utilizado para controlar un bucle de computación interno. El agotamiento de recursos resultante degrada la disponibilidad para otras operaciones.

desc: A MongoDB server initiating an outbound TLS connection may terminate abnormally when processing a malformed OCSP response from a remote peer during the TLS handshake. OCSP stapling validation is enabled by default for outgoing TLS connections. Affected scenarios require the remote peer to hold a certificate issued by the cluster's trusted certificate authority, or for the connection to traverse an untrusted network path.
desc_es: Un servidor MongoDB que inicia una conexión TLS saliente puede terminar de forma anómala al procesar una respuesta OCSP malformada de un par remoto durante el handshake TLS. La validación de OCSP stapling está habilitada por defecto para las conexiones TLS salientes. Los escenarios afectados requieren que el par remoto posea un certificado emitido por la autoridad de certificación de confianza del clúster, o que la conexión atraviese una ruta de red no confiable.

desc: An authenticated user with read access can cause the mongod process to be terminated through certain aggregation expressions that execute server-side JavaScript. The issue involves improper memory handling during document processing.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con acceso de lectura puede causar la terminación del proceso mongod a través de ciertas expresiones de agregación que ejecutan JavaScript del lado del servidor. El problema implica un manejo inadecuado de la memoria durante el procesamiento de documentos.

desc: When compute mode is enabled on a standalone mongod instance, insufficient validation of externally sourced BSON data during aggregation pipeline processing can result in memory corruption, potentially leading to process termination or other unintended behavior. This configuration is non-default and requires explicit enablement at startup.
desc_es: Cuando el modo de cómputo está habilitado en una instancia mongod independiente, una validación insuficiente de datos BSON de origen externo durante el procesamiento de la pipeline de agregación puede resultar en corrupción de memoria, lo que podría llevar a la terminación del proceso u otro comportamiento no deseado. Esta configuración no es la predeterminada y requiere habilitación explícita al inicio.

desc: An authenticated user with read-only privileges can cause the mongod process to terminate abnormally by issuing a crafted aggregation command, resulting in denial of service for all connected clients until the process is restarted. The issue stems from an internal engine selection inconsistency triggered by a specific combination of aggregation options.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con privilegios de solo lectura puede provocar que el proceso mongod termine de forma anómala al emitir un comando de agregación manipulado, lo que resulta en denegación de servicio para todos los clientes conectados hasta que se reinicie el proceso. El problema se deriva de una inconsistencia interna en la selección del motor desencadenada por una combinación específica de opciones de agregación.

desc: An authenticated user may be able to view session metadata belonging to other users on the system through the $listSessions aggregation stage. This information is normally restricted to users with cluster-level administrative privileges, and includes active session identifiers, associated usernames, and activity timestamps.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado podría ver metadatos de sesión pertenecientes a otros usuarios en el sistema a través de la etapa de agregación $listSessions. Esta información normalmente está restringida a usuarios con privilegios administrativos a nivel de clúster, e incluye identificadores de sesión activos, nombres de usuario asociados y marcas de tiempo de actividad.

desc: An authenticated user with write privileges on a Queryable Encryption-enabled collection may be able to modify internal encryption metadata fields that are intended to be server-controlled, by sending crafted write commands through the mongos router on a sharded cluster. This can result in corruption of encrypted query correctness.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con privilegios de escritura en una colección con Cifrado Consultable habilitado podría modificar campos de metadatos de cifrado internos que están destinados a ser controlados por el servidor, enviando comandos de escritura manipulados a través del router mongos en un clúster fragmentado. Esto puede resultar en corrupción de la corrección de consultas cifradas.

desc: An authenticated user with standard read/write privileges can cause the mongod process to terminate due to an out-of-memory condition by sending a crafted aggregation command. MongoDB's libmongocrypt library insufficiently validates payload-supplied values, which can result in an excessively large memory allocation.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con privilegios estándar de lectura/escritura puede provocar la terminación del proceso mongod debido a una condición de agotamiento de memoria al enviar un comando de agregación manipulado. La biblioteca libmongocrypt de MongoDB valida insuficientemente los valores proporcionados en la carga útil, lo que puede resultar en una asignación de memoria excesivamente grande.

desc: Certain query operations involving deeply nested $jsonSchema constructs can trigger disproportionate CPU consumption in affected MongoDB deployments, potentially leading to resource exhaustion. The resulting CPU-bound operation cannot be interrupted through standard administrative controls.
desc_es: Ciertas operaciones de consulta que involucran constructos $jsonSchema profundamente anidados pueden desencadenar un consumo desproporcionado de CPU en implementaciones de MongoDB afectadas, lo que podría llevar al agotamiento de recursos. La operación resultante ligada a la CPU no puede ser interrumpida a través de controles administrativos estándar.

desc: A user with read-only privileges is able to craft an aggregation pipeline using the $linearFill window function operator with a specific sortBy expression type to cause the mongod process to terminate abnormally, resulting in denial of service. The issue stems from insufficient validation of sort specifications during execution.
desc_es: Un usuario con privilegios de solo lectura es capaz de elaborar una pipeline de agregación utilizando el operador de función de ventana $linearFill con un tipo de expresión sortBy específico para causar que el proceso mongod termine de forma anómala, resultando en denegación de servicio. El problema se deriva de una validación insuficiente de las especificaciones de ordenación durante la ejecución.

desc: Improper handling of DBPointer objects during BSON serialization in MongoDB's server-side JavaScript engine can result in internal process memory contents being included in data returned to the client. This constitutes an unintended information disclosure affecting deployments that use server-side JavaScript.
desc_es: Manejo inadecuado de objetos DBPointer durante la serialización BSON en el motor JavaScript del servidor de MongoDB puede resultar en que los contenidos de la memoria interna del proceso sean incluidos en los datos devueltos al cliente. Esto constituye una revelación de información no intencionada que afecta a las implementaciones que utilizan JavaScript del lado del servidor.

desc: When PROXY protocol v2 is used on the Unix domain socket path, roles derived from X.509 client certificates may not be validated against the configured tlsCATrusts allow-list. This can result in unintended role assignments following MONGODB-X509 authentication. Affected scenarios require local access to the proxy Unix domain socket and a valid X.509 certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority.
desc_es: Cuando se utiliza el PROXY protocol v2 en la ruta del socket de dominio Unix, los roles derivados de los certificados de cliente X.509 pueden no ser validados contra la lista de permitidos tlsCATrusts configurada. Esto puede resultar en asignaciones de roles no intencionadas después de la autenticación MONGODB-X509. Los escenarios afectados requieren acceso local al socket de dominio Unix del proxy y un certificado X.509 válido emitido por una autoridad de certificación de confianza.

desc: The `$_internalIndexKey` aggregation expression can be used by any authenticated user to crash a MongoDB server (mongod). The expression fails to handle compound wildcard index specifications, triggering an internal consistency check that aborts the server process. The user must be able to run an aggregation pipeline.
desc_es: La expresión de agregación ’$_internalIndexKey’ puede ser utilizada por cualquier usuario autenticado para colapsar un servidor MongoDB (mongod). La expresión no logra manejar especificaciones de índice comodín compuesto, lo que desencadena una comprobación de consistencia interna que aborta el proceso del servidor. El usuario debe ser capaz de ejecutar una pipeline de agregación.

desc: Using expressions that generate large arrays it is possible to craft a query that creates very large intermediate objects in memory, causing the server to crash with OOM error.
desc_es: Usando expresiones que generan grandes arreglos, es posible diseñar una consulta que crea objetos intermedios muy grandes en memoria, causando que el servidor se bloquee con un error de OOM.

desc:
An issue in the server’s Atlas Search integration allows an authenticated user to bypass per-user access controls.



In sharded topologies, the $search and $searchMeta aggregation stages use internal routing that is normally populated only by the trusted router during sharded search planning. Due to insufficient input validation, an authenticated client can supply these fields directly.
desc_es:
Un problema en la integración de Atlas Search del servidor permite a un usuario autenticado eludir los controles de acceso por usuario.

En topologías fragmentadas, las etapas de agregación $search y $searchMeta utilizan enrutamiento interno que normalmente es poblado solo por el router de confianza durante la planificación de búsqueda fragmentada. Debido a una validación de entrada insuficiente, un cliente autenticado puede proporcionar estos campos directamente.

desc: An authenticated user with basic write privileges can cause the mongod process to terminate abnormally by sending a crafted transaction command with an incomplete set of required fields. The issue stems from inconsistent validation across related transaction command parameters, resulting in a fatal internal invariant failure and denial of service.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con privilegios básicos de escritura puede causar que el proceso mongod termine anormalmente al enviar un comando de transacción manipulado con un conjunto incompleto de campos requeridos. El problema se deriva de una validación inconsistente entre los parámetros de comandos de transacción relacionados, lo que resulta en un fallo fatal de invariante interno y denegación de servicio.

desc: An authenticated user with low privileges may be able to perform unauthorized reads and writes on data protected by role-based query-level access controls, due to insufficient validation of certain client-supplied command parameters. The issue affects find, update, delete, and aggregate commands in non-apiStrict configurations.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con privilegios bajos podría realizar lecturas y escrituras no autorizadas sobre datos protegidos por controles de acceso a nivel de consulta basados en roles, debido a una validación insuficiente de ciertos parámetros de comando suministrados por el cliente. El problema afecta a los comandos find, update, delete y aggregate en configuraciones no apiStrict.

desc: An authenticated user with limited read privileges may be able to access documents from collections they are not authorized to read, due to an inconsistency in how the $graphLookup aggregation stage is evaluated during authorization and during execution. Affected scenarios involve collections referenced within existing view pipeline definitions.
desc_es: Un usuario autenticado con privilegios de lectura limitados podría acceder a documentos de colecciones que no está autorizado a leer, debido a una inconsistencia en cómo se evalúa la etapa de agregación $graphLookup durante la autorización y durante la ejecución. Los escenarios afectados involucran colecciones referenciadas dentro de definiciones de pipeline de vista existentes.

desc: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator and IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.0.0 through 6.2.0.5_2,  6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.1_2, and  6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.0_1 could allow an unauthenticated user to read sensitive information by bypassing authentication through a specially crafted HTTP request.

ONTAP versions 9.16.1 and higher with WebAuthn multi-factor authentication (MFA) configured are susceptible to a vulnerability related to the Relying Party ID which when successfully exploited could allow an attacker with valid credentials to bypass MFA.
desc_es: Las versiones de ONTAP 9.16.1 y superiores con autenticación multifactor (MFA) WebAuthn configurada son susceptibles a una vulnerabilidad relacionada con el ID de la parte de confianza que, cuando se explota con éxito, podría permitir a un atacante con credenciales válidas eludir la MFA.

desc: Cal.com OSS ships lacks authorization on webhook teamId creation, allowing any authenticated user to create a webhook on any team via unvalidated teamId injection, then steal booking data, including fields like organizer/attendee emails and custom responses, and conditionally video-call passwords, by triggering webhook delivery.
desc_es: Cal.com OSS carece de autorización en la creación de teamId de webhook, permitiendo a cualquier usuario autenticado crear un webhook en cualquier equipo mediante la inyección de un teamId no validado, para luego robar datos de reserva, incluyendo campos como correos electrónicos de organizador/asistente y respuestas personalizadas, y, condicionalmente, contraseñas de videollamadas, al activar la entrega del webhook.

desc: Elgg before 7.0.0 does not check image dimensions to prevent denial of service via a large avatar upload.

FFmpeg versions 4.4 through 8.1.2 contain a double-free vulnerability in the NVIDIA NVDEC hardware decoder within libavcodec/nvdec.c that allows attackers to trigger memory corruption by supplying a crafted video file. When no decoder surfaces remain, the ff_nvdec_start_frame_sep_ref error path frees memory via nvdec_fdd_priv_free while the calling layer subsequently frees the same frame description data, resulting in a double-free of the underlying decoder context in any FFmpeg-based application using NVDEC hardware-accelerated decoding.
desc_es: Las versiones de FFmpeg 4.4 a 8.1.2 contienen una vulnerabilidad de doble liberación de memoria (double-free) en el decodificador de hardware NVIDIA NVDEC dentro de libavcodec/nvdec.c que permite a los atacantes provocar corrupción de memoria al proporcionar un archivo de video manipulado. Cuando no quedan superficies de decodificador, la ruta de error ff_nvdec_start_frame_sep_ref libera memoria a través de nvdec_fdd_priv_free mientras que la capa llamante libera posteriormente los mismos datos de descripción de fotograma, lo que resulta en una doble liberación de memoria (double-free) del contexto del decodificador subyacente en cualquier aplicación basada en FFmpeg que utilice la decodificación acelerada por hardware NVDEC.

desc: FFmpeg versions 0.7.1 through 8.1.2 contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the S/PDIF muxer that allows attackers to access memory beyond buffer boundaries by supplying a crafted DTS stream with a core_size value larger than the actual packet length. Attackers can exploit the missing bounds check in the spdif_header_dts4 function by providing a malicious DTS-HD audio stream during S/PDIF re-muxing to trigger unauthorized memory reads beyond the packet buffer.
desc_es: Las versiones de FFmpeg 0.7.1 a 8.1.2 contienen una vulnerabilidad de lectura fuera de límites en el multiplexor S/PDIF que permite a los atacantes acceder a la memoria más allá de los límites del búfer al proporcionar un flujo DTS manipulado con un valor de core_size mayor que la longitud real del paquete. Los atacantes pueden explotar la comprobación de límites faltante en la función spdif_header_dts4 al proporcionar un flujo de audio DTS-HD malicioso durante la remultiplexación S/PDIF para desencadenar lecturas de memoria no autorizadas más allá del búfer de paquetes.

desc: FFmpeg versions 0.6.3 through 8.1.2 contain an infinite loop vulnerability in the RTP/ASF demuxer within libavformat/rtpdec_asf.c that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by sending a crafted RTP/ASF stream. The rtp_asf_fix_header function fails to validate a minimum chunksize when iterating over ASF objects, causing the loop pointer to never advance when a chunksize is smaller than the 24-byte minimum ASF object header size, resulting in CPU exhaustion that denies service to legitimate users.
desc_es: Las versiones 0.6.3 a 8.1.2 de FFmpeg contienen una vulnerabilidad de bucle infinito en el demuxer RTP/ASF dentro de libavformat/rtpdec_asf.c que permite a atacantes remotos causar denegación de servicio al enviar un flujo RTP/ASF manipulado. La función rtp_asf_fix_header no valida un tamaño de fragmento mínimo al iterar sobre objetos ASF, lo que provoca que el puntero del bucle nunca avance cuando un tamaño de fragmento es menor que el tamaño mínimo de encabezado de objeto ASF de 24 bytes, lo que resulta en el agotamiento de la CPU que deniega el servicio a usuarios legítimos.

desc: FFmpeg versions 4.4 through 8.1.2 contain an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in the ADX audio decoder within libavcodec/adxdec.c that allows attackers to trigger both out-of-bounds reads and writes by supplying a crafted ADX or AAX audio file with a mid-stream channel layout change. When AV_PKT_DATA_NEW_EXTRADATA side data is received mid-stream, the adx_decode_frame function re-parses the stream header but fails to update the internal channel state, causing subsequent decoding operations to access the prev[] state array using a stale channel count.
desc_es: Las versiones 4.4 a 8.1.2 de FFmpeg contienen una vulnerabilidad de acceso a memoria fuera de límites en el decodificador de audio ADX dentro de libavcodec/adxdec.c que permite a los atacantes activar tanto lecturas como escrituras fuera de límites al proporcionar un archivo de audio ADX o AAX manipulado con un cambio de diseño de canal a mitad de flujo. Cuando se reciben datos laterales AV_PKT_DATA_NEW_EXTRADATA a mitad de flujo, la función adx_decode_frame vuelve a analizar el encabezado del flujo pero no actualiza el estado interno del canal, lo que provoca que las operaciones de decodificación subsiguientes accedan al array de estado prev[] utilizando un recuento de canales obsoleto.

desc: Duplicati v2.3.0.1 backup software gives Authenticated Users MODIFY permissions that propagate to all subdirectories. Installing the software outside of the Program Files directory, or on a custom path, creates a LocalSystem service running from a directory that any standard local user can write to. A standard local user can overwrite any DLL in the service directory. On service restart, the OS loads the attacker's DLL before any managed code runs, executing arbitrary code as SYSTEM.

Onlook through 0.2.32, fixed in commit 423e2e9, contains a broken object level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to access and manipulate other users' resources by supplying arbitrary UUID values to tRPC API procedures including project.get, member.remove, and chat.conversation.delete. Attackers can provide arbitrary projectId or conversationId values without authorization validation to read, modify, and delete other users' project data, members, and conversation history.
desc_es: Onlook hasta la versión 0.2.32, corregida en el commit 423e2e9, contiene una vulnerabilidad de autorización a nivel de objeto rota que permite a atacantes autenticados acceder y manipular los recursos de otros usuarios al proporcionar valores UUID arbitrarios a los procedimientos de la API de tRPC, incluyendo project.get, member.remove y chat.conversation.delete. Los atacantes pueden proporcionar valores arbitrarios de projectId o conversationId sin validación de autorización para leer, modificar y eliminar datos de proyectos, miembros e historial de conversaciones de otros usuarios.

desc:
Missing authorization in Caliptra Core Runtime Firmware (INVOKE_DPE_MLDSA87, CM_AES_GCM_DECRYPT_DMA, EXTERNAL_MAILBOX_CMD commands) in subsystem mode allows a privileged local attacker to cause a denial of service via mailbox commands containing unverified AXI addresses. The security impact beyond availability is integration-specific.

This issue affects Core Runtime Firmware: 2.1.0.
desc_es:
Falta de autorización en el firmware de tiempo de ejecución del núcleo de Caliptra (comandos INVOKE_DPE_MLDSA87, CM_AES_GCM_DECRYPT_DMA, EXTERNAL_MAILBOX_CMD) en modo subsistema permite a un atacante local privilegiado causar una denegación de servicio a través de comandos de buzón que contienen direcciones AXI no verificadas. El impacto de seguridad más allá de la disponibilidad es específico de la integración.

Este problema afecta al firmware de tiempo de ejecución del núcleo: 2.1.0.

desc: FFmpeg versions 2.1 through 8.1.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the VobSub subtitle demuxer that allows attackers to corrupt adjacent heap memory by supplying a malicious .sub/.idx subtitle file declaring more distinct stream IDs than the fixed-size array bounds in libavformat/mpeg.c. Attackers can craft a subtitle file with excessive distinct stream IDs to trigger unbounded writes beyond the vobsub->q[] array boundary via ff_subtitles_queue_insert(), potentially achieving arbitrary code execution in any application using FFmpeg's VobSub demuxer.
desc_es: Las versiones de FFmpeg 2.1 a 8.1.2 contienen una vulnerabilidad de desbordamiento de búfer de pila en el demuxer de subtítulos VobSub que permite a los atacantes corromper memoria adyacente del heap al proporcionar un archivo de subtítulos .sub/.idx malicioso que declara más IDs de flujo distintos que los límites del array de tamaño fijo en libavformat/mpeg.c. Los atacantes pueden crear un archivo de subtítulos con IDs de flujo distintos excesivos para desencadenar escrituras ilimitadas más allá del límite del array vobsub  ->  q[] a través de ff_subtitles_queue_insert(), logrando potencialmente la ejecución de código arbitrario en cualquier aplicación que utilice el demuxer VobSub de FFmpeg.

desc: FFmpeg versions 8.0 through 8.1.2 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the Vulkan HEVC hardware decoder that allows remote attackers to overwrite return addresses and adjacent stack frames by supplying a crafted HEVC/H.265 bitstream. Attackers can embed a malicious vps_num_hrd_parameters value exceeding HEVC_MAX_SUB_LAYERS in any supported container format to overflow stack-allocated arrays in the vk_hevc_end_frame function, potentially achieving arbitrary code execution.
desc_es: Las versiones de FFmpeg 8.0 a 8.1.2 contienen una vulnerabilidad de desbordamiento de búfer de pila en el decodificador de hardware Vulkan HEVC que permite a atacantes remotos sobrescribir direcciones de retorno y marcos de pila adyacentes al proporcionar un flujo de bits HEVC/H.265 manipulado. Los atacantes pueden incrustar un valor malicioso de vps_num_hrd_parameters que excede HEVC_MAX_SUB_LAYERS en cualquier formato de contenedor compatible para desbordar arreglos asignados en la pila en la función vk_hevc_end_frame, logrando potencialmente la ejecución de código arbitrario.

desc: Graylog2 Server before commit 46a2eeb contains a missing per-entity permission check in the POST /events/definitions/{definitionId}/duplicate endpoint that allows authenticated users to clone any event definition. Attackers with the low-privilege eventdefinitions:create capability can read private event definitions including detection queries, aggregation thresholds, grouping fields, schedules, and notification bindings by duplicating them.
desc_es: Graylog2 Servidor antes del commit 46a2eeb contiene una comprobación de permisos por entidad faltante en el endpoint POST /events/definitions/{definitionId}/duplicate que permite a usuarios autenticados clonar cualquier definición de evento. Atacantes con la capacidad de bajo privilegio ’eventdefinitions:create’ pueden leer definiciones de eventos privadas, incluyendo consultas de detección, umbrales de agregación, campos de agrupación, programaciones y enlaces de notificación, duplicándolas.

desc: InvokeAI before 6.13.7 contains an unauthenticated directory enumeration vulnerability in the GET /api/v2/models/scan_folder endpoint that accepts attacker-controlled scan_path parameters. Unauthenticated attackers can recursively enumerate arbitrary server filesystem directories and use HTTP response codes to determine file existence and readability, bypassing multi-user mode access controls.
desc_es: InvokeAI anterior a 6.13.7 contiene una vulnerabilidad de enumeración de directorios no autenticada en el endpoint GET /API/v2/models/scan_folder que acepta parámetros scan_path controlados por el atacante. Atacantes no autenticados pueden enumerar recursivamente directorios arbitrarios del sistema de archivos del servidor y usar códigos de respuesta HTTP para determinar la existencia y legibilidad de archivos, eludiendo los controles de acceso del modo multiusuario.

desc: A flaw was found in librest. The PKCE implementation for OAuth authorization uses the GRand function from the GLib API, a cryptographically insecure pseudo-random number generator. Because the generated "code verifier" lacks sufficient cryptographic entropy, a malicious actor can reverse-engineer the pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) seed to predict or reconstruct the code verifier string, allowing an attacker to bypass PKCE protections and successfully impersonate the client during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.

Froiden TableTrack through 1.3.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary HTML and JavaScript through the order notes field without sanitization. Attackers can craft malicious payloads in customer order placement that execute in the admin's browser session when viewing order details, enabling session token theft or unauthorized administrative actions.
desc_es: Froiden TableTrack hasta la versión 1.3.10 contiene una vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting almacenado que permite a atacantes no autenticados inyectar HTML y JavaScript arbitrarios a través del campo de notas del pedido sin saneamiento. Los atacantes pueden crear cargas útiles maliciosas al realizar pedidos de clientes que se ejecutan en la sesión del navegador del administrador al ver los detalles del pedido, lo que permite el robo de tokens de sesión o acciones administrativas no autorizadas.

desc: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versions prior to 20.2.0.0, contain(s) a Generation of Incorrect Security Tokens vulnerability in the IAM. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of privileges.
desc_es: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versiones anteriores a la 20.2.0.0, contiene una vulnerabilidad de Generación de Tokens de Seguridad Incorrectos en el IAM. Un atacante con privilegios bajos y acceso remoto podría potencialmente explotar esta vulnerabilidad, lo que lleva a una Elevación de privilegios.

desc: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versions prior to 20.2.0.0, contain(s) an Improper Input Validation vulnerability in the REST API. A high privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Remote execution.
desc_es: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versiones anteriores a 20.2.0.0, contiene una vulnerabilidad de validación de entrada incorrecta en la API REST. Un atacante con altos privilegios y acceso remoto podría potencialmente explotar esta vulnerabilidad, lo que lleva a la ejecución remota.

desc: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versions prior to 20.2.0.0, contain(s) an Improper Input Validation vulnerability in the REST API. A high privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of privileges.
desc_es: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versiones anteriores a la 20.2.0.0, contiene una vulnerabilidad de validación de entrada incorrecta en la API REST. Un atacante con altos privilegios con acceso remoto podría potencialmente explotar esta vulnerabilidad, lo que llevaría a una Elevación de privilegios.

desc: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versions prior to 20.2.0.0, contain(s) an Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability in the REST API. A high privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.
desc_es: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versiones anteriores a 20.2.0.0, contiene una vulnerabilidad de Exposición de Información Sensible a un Actor No Autorizado en la API REST. Un atacante con altos privilegios con acceso local podría potencialmente explotar esta vulnerabilidad, lo que llevaría a la exposición de información.

desc: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versions prior to 20.2.0.0, contain(s) an Improper Input Validation vulnerability in the REST API. A high privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of privileges.
desc_es: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versiones anteriores a la 20.2.0.0, contiene una vulnerabilidad de validación de entrada incorrecta en la API REST. Un atacante con altos privilegios con acceso remoto podría potencialmente explotar esta vulnerabilidad, lo que llevaría a una Elevación de privilegios.

desc: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versions prior to 20.2.0.0, contain(s) an Improper Input Validation vulnerability. A high privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of privileges.
desc_es: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager, versiones anteriores a la 20.2.0.0, contiene una vulnerabilidad de validación de entrada incorrecta. Un atacante con altos privilegios y acceso remoto podría potencialmente explotar esta vulnerabilidad, lo que llevaría a una elevación de privilegios.

desc: A vulnerability in Fujitsu Software Linux openFT and Fujitsu Software Oracle Solaris openFT before version 12.1D00 allows for unauthenticated remote code execution (pre-auth RCE) on GNU/Linux or Oracle Solaris. The Fsas Technologies PSIRT obtained that intelligence internally and covers the CVE beyond its CNA scope under existing agreement with Fujitsu Germany.

A vulnerability in Fujitsu Software Linux openFT and Fujitsu Software Oracle Solaris openFT before version 12.1D00 allows for local privilege escalation to root of an already authenticated user on GNU/Linux or Oracle Solaris. The Fsas Technologies PSIRT obtained that intelligence internally and covers the CVE beyond its CNA scope under existing agreement with Fujitsu Germany.

libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. Versions 1.19.0 through 1.21.2 have a heap OOB read in ImageItem_Grid::decode_grid_tile via irot-induced tile-coordinate underflow. Version 1.22.0 fixes the issue.
desc_es: libheif es un decodificador y codificador de formato de archivo HEIF y AVIF. Las versiones 1.19.0 a la 1.21.2 tienen una lectura fuera de límites (OOB) en el heap en ImageItem_Grid::decode_grid_tile a través de un subdesbordamiento de coordenadas de mosaico inducido por irot. La versión 1.22.0 corrige el problema.

desc:
Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in Xpoda Türkiye Informatics Technology Inc. No Code Platform allows SQL Injection.

This issue affects No Code Platform: from 4.1.3 before 4.1.4.
desc_es:
