desc:
AIL Framework contains a path traversal vulnerability in its PDF object handling. Prior to commit 14c618fce4d1df02358717c48ea903706abecdf2, the PDF.get_filepath() function constructed a file path by joining the configured PDF storage directory with a path derived from a PDF object identifier, without verifying that the resolved path remained within the intended PDF_FOLDER directory.

An authenticated attacker able to invoke PDF object operations with a crafted identifier could use relative traversal sequences or absolute path components to cause AIL Framework to open files located outside the PDF storage directory. This could allow disclosure of files readable by the AIL process, including application configuration, credentials, or other sensitive local data. This vulnerability is potential due to additional errors before being able to be executed.

The fix canonicalises the resulting path with os.path.realpath() and rejects paths whose common directory is outside the configured PDF directory.
desc_es:
AIL Framework contiene una vulnerabilidad de salto de ruta en su manejo de objetos PDF. Antes del commit 14c618fce4d1df02358717c48ea903706abecdf2, la función PDF.get_filepath() construía una ruta de archivo uniendo el directorio de almacenamiento de PDF configurado con una ruta derivada de un identificador de objeto PDF, sin verificar que la ruta resuelta permaneciera dentro del directorio PDF_FOLDER previsto.

Un atacante autenticado capaz de invocar operaciones de objetos PDF con un identificador manipulado podría usar secuencias de salto relativas o componentes de ruta absolutos para hacer que AIL Framework abriera archivos ubicados fuera del directorio de almacenamiento de PDF. Esto podría permitir la divulgación de archivos legibles por el proceso AIL, incluyendo la configuración de la aplicación, credenciales u otros datos locales sensibles. Esta vulnerabilidad es potencial debido a errores adicionales antes de poder ser ejecutada.

La solución canoniza la ruta resultante con os.path.realpath() y rechaza las rutas cuyo directorio común está fuera del directorio PDF configurado.

desc:
A flaw exists in the org.keycloak.broker.oidc package where the OIDC broker incorrectly synchronizes the email_verified claim. When an OIDC identity provider is configured with trustEmail=true and the userinfo endpoint is enabled, Keycloak retrieves the email address from the userinfo response but retrieves the email_verified status exclusively from the id_token.
The root cause is a lack of validation ensuring that the email_verified claim in the id_token actually refers to the email address returned by the userinfo endpoint. If these two sources return different email addresses, the id_token's email_verified=true claim is blindly applied to the userinfo email.
Exploitation Conditions:
The OIDC identity provider must have trustEmail set to true (non-default).

The userinfo endpoint must be enabled (default).

The attacker must control or have compromised the upstream OIDC provider.


Concrete Impact:
Mark arbitrary email addresses as verified in the Keycloak database.

Bypass email-based security controls or verification workflows.

Potential account takeover if the application relies solely on the email_verified flag from the IdP to link accounts.

desc: A weakness has been identified in zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent 2.1.0. This issue affects the function verify_server of the file channel/wechatmp/common.py of the component wx Endpoint. This manipulation of the argument wechatmp_token causes missing authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 2.1.1 is capable of addressing this issue. Patch name: 3d7c68bac6ee74fad63f43cf99e45c62e202ed55. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The project confirms: "We've added an explicit non-empty check for wechatmp_token in verify_server() so that the /wx endpoint now fails closed with 403 Forbidden whenever the token is missing or left at the default empty value, instead of relying on a signature check that silently degenerates to a predictable hash."

Nombre del parche: 3d7c68bac6ee74fad63f43cf99e45c62e202ed55. Se sugiere actualizar el componente afectado. El proyecto confirma: ’Hemos añadido una comprobación explícita de no vacío para wechatmp_token en verify_server() para que el endpoint /wx ahora falle cerrado con 403 Forbidden siempre que el token falte o se deje con el valor vacío predeterminado, en lugar de depender de una comprobación de firma que degenera silenciosamente en un hash predecible.’

desc:
Crypt::DSA versions before 1.22 for Perl draw the DSA signing nonce and private key from a biased random generator, leading to private-key recovery.

"Crypt::DSA::Util::makerandom forces the high bit of every value it returns to obtain an exactly N-bit integer for prime search. The signing nonce and the private key are drawn from makerandom. Because the high bit is always set, the result is not uniform: its top bit is fixed, producing insecure values."

An attacker who collects a modest number of signatures under an affected key, together with the public key, can recover the private key with a lattice attack.

Keys used to sign with an affected version should be considered compromised and new keys should be generated.
desc_es:
Las versiones de Crypt::DSA anteriores a la 1.22 para Perl obtienen el nonce de firma DSA y la clave privada de un generador de números aleatorios sesgado, lo que lleva a la recuperación de la clave privada.

’Crypt::DSA::Util::makerandom fuerza el bit más significativo de cada valor que devuelve para obtener un entero de exactamente N bits para la búsqueda de primos. El nonce de firma y la clave privada se obtienen de makerandom. Debido a que el bit más significativo siempre está establecido, el resultado no es uniforme: su bit superior está fijo, produciendo valores inseguros.’

Un atacante que recopila un número modesto de firmas bajo una clave afectada, junto con la clave pública, puede recuperar la clave privada con un ataque de celosía.

Las claves utilizadas para firmar con una versión afectada deben considerarse comprometidas y se deben generar nuevas claves.

desc:
The silent Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning feature in federated authentication implementations fails to properly segregate user roles during account creation when a federated user shares a username with a local user. This allows the provisioning process to overwrite existing roles of local users with roles assigned to the federated user.

Exploitation requires a federated identity provider (IDP) with silent JIT provisioning enabled and an attacker's knowledge of a local user's username. When these conditions are met, a malicious individual can leverage the JIT provisioning process to modify the roles of local users. The overwritten roles are limited to those defined within the federated IDP, typically granting minimal access rights unless explicitly configured otherwise by the federated IDP administrator.

Plack::Middleware::OAuth versions through 0.10 for Perl do not support the OAuth 2.0 state parameter.

RequestTokenV2 builds the provider authorization redirect without issuing a state value, and AccessTokenV2 exchanges the callback code and registers the resulting token into the session (register_session) without verifying that the callback corresponds to an authorization request this session initiated.

Any application that uses this middleware for OAuth 2.0 login is exposed to login cross-site request forgery: because the callback is not bound to the session that began the flow, an attacker who starts an authorization with their own provider account can deliver the resulting callback to a victim, causing the victim's session to complete the attacker's authorization and associating the attacker's provider identity and access token with that session. Where the application persists this as an account link, the attacker may retain access to the victim's account through their own provider credentials.
desc_es:
Las versiones de Plack::Middleware::OAuth hasta la 0.10 para Perl no soportan el parámetro state de OAuth 2.0.

RequestTokenV2 construye la redirección de autorización del proveedor sin emitir un valor state, y AccessTokenV2 intercambia el código de devolución de llamada y registra el token resultante en la sesión (register_session) sin verificar que la devolución de llamada corresponde a una petición de autorización que esta sesión inició.

Cualquier aplicación que usa este middleware para el inicio de sesión de OAuth 2.0 está expuesta a la falsificación de petición en sitios cruzados de inicio de sesión: debido a que la devolución de llamada no está vinculada a la sesión que inició el flujo, un atacante que inicia una autorización con su propia cuenta de proveedor puede entregar la devolución de llamada resultante a una víctima, haciendo que la sesión de la víctima complete la autorización del atacante y asociando la identidad del proveedor y el token de acceso del atacante con esa sesión. Donde la aplicación persiste esto como un enlace de cuenta, el atacante puede retener el acceso a la cuenta de la víctima a través de sus propias credenciales de proveedor.

desc_es:
Las versiones de Dancer2::Plugin::Auth::OAuth::Provider anteriores a 0.23 para Perl no son compatibles con el parámetro state de OAuth 2.0.

El método authentication_url construye la redirección de autorización del proveedor sin emitir un valor state, y el método callback intercambia el código de callback y registra el token resultante en la sesión sin verificar que el callback corresponde a una petición de autorización que esta sesión inició.

Cualquier aplicación que utilice este plugin para el inicio de sesión de OAuth 2.0 está expuesta a la falsificación de petición en sitios cruzados de inicio de sesión: porque el callback no está vinculado a la sesión que inició el flujo, un atacante que inicia una autorización con su propia cuenta de proveedor puede entregar el callback resultante a una víctima, haciendo que la sesión de la víctima complete la autorización del atacante y asociando la identidad del proveedor y el token de acceso del atacante con esa sesión. Donde la aplicación persiste esto como un enlace de cuenta, el atacante puede retener el acceso a la cuenta de la víctima a través de sus propias credenciales de proveedor.

desc: In Trail of Bits fickling versions up to and including 0.1.11, the UnsafeImportsML analysis pass unconditionally calls AnalysisContext.shorten_code(node) on every import node it inspects, regardless of whether the import is flagged as unsafe. This call registers the shortened code representation in the shared AnalysisContext.reported_shortened_code set. When the MLAllowlist analysis pass subsequently runs, it calls the same shorten_code() method, receives already_reported=True for every import, and executes a continue statement that skips its allowlist check entirely. This renders MLAllowlist dead code for all imports — it never evaluates whether an import is in the ML allowlist or not. The MLAllowlist pass was designed to catch imports of modules outside the known-safe ML ecosystem (torch, numpy, transformers, etc.) that slip past the UnsafeImports denylist. With MLAllowlist inoperative, any standard library module not in the UNSAFE_IMPORTS denylist can be invoked via pickle deserialization while fickling's check_safety() returns LIKELY_SAFE. The fickling.load() API chains check_safety() into pickle.loads() as an explicit security gate, meaning a LIKELY_SAFE verdict causes the payload to be deserialized and executed. The root cause is shared mutable state between independently-correct analysis passes — UnsafeImportsML works as designed in isolation, MLAllowlist works as designed in isolation, but the shared reported_shortened_code set causes UnsafeImportsML to poison MLAllowlist's deduplication logic.
desc_es: En las versiones de fickling de Trail of Bits hasta la 0.1.11 inclusive, la pasada de análisis UnsafeImportsML llama incondicionalmente a AnalysisContext.shorten_code(node) en cada nodo de importación que inspecciona, independientemente de si la importación está marcada como insegura. Esta llamada registra la representación de código acortada en el conjunto compartido AnalysisContext.reported_shortened_code. Cuando la pasada de análisis MLAllowlist se ejecuta posteriormente, llama al mismo método shorten_code(), recibe already_reported=True para cada importación y ejecuta una sentencia continue que omite completamente su verificación de lista de permitidos. Esto convierte a MLAllowlist en código muerto para todas las importaciones - nunca evalúa si una importación está en la lista de permitidos de ML o no. La pasada MLAllowlist fue diseñada para detectar importaciones de módulos fuera del ecosistema de ML conocido como seguro (torch, numpy, transformers, etc.) que escapan a la lista de denegados de UnsafeImports. Con MLAllowlist inoperativa, cualquier módulo de la biblioteca estándar que no esté en la lista de denegados UNSAFE_IMPORTS puede ser invocado a través de la deserialización de pickle mientras que check_safety() de fickling devuelve LIKELY_SAFE. La API fickling.load() encadena check_safety() en pickle.loads() como una puerta de seguridad explícita, lo que significa que un veredicto LIKELY_SAFE hace que la carga útil sea deserializada y ejecutada. La causa raíz es el estado mutable compartido entre pasadas de análisis independientemente correctas - UnsafeImportsML funciona según lo diseñado de forma aislada, MLAllowlist funciona según lo diseñado de forma aislada, pero el conjunto compartido reported_shortened_code hace que UnsafeImportsML envenene la lógica de deduplicación de MLAllowlist.

desc: A flaw has been found in RT-Thread up to 5.2.2. Affected is the function read/write/sys_ioctl of the file components/lwp/lwp_syscall.c of the component Parameter Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to divide by zero. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

Trail of Bits fickling versions up to and including 0.1.10 do not include the Python standard library modules _posixsubprocess, site, and atexit in the UNSAFE_IMPORTS denylist (fickle.py). Because these modules are absent from the denylist, fickling's check_safety() function returns LIKELY_SAFE with zero findings for pickle payloads that invoke dangerous functions including _posixsubprocess.fork_exec (C-level process spawner capable of executing arbitrary binaries), site.execsitecustomize (executes arbitrary site customization code), and atexit._run_exitfuncs (triggers all registered exit handler callbacks). The fickling.load() API chains check_safety() into pickle.loads() as an explicit security gate; a LIKELY_SAFE verdict causes the payload to be deserialized and executed. This shares the same root cause as CVE-2026-22607 (cProfile), CVE-2025-67748 (pty), and CVE-2025-67747 (marshal/types). OvertlyBadEvals does not flag these modules because they are standard library imports. UnsafeImports does not flag them because they are not in the denylist. The UnusedVariables heuristic is defeated by the SETITEMS opcode pattern.
desc_es: Las versiones de fickling de Trail of Bits hasta la 0.1.10 inclusive no incluyen los módulos de la biblioteca estándar de Python _posixsubprocess, site y atexit en la lista de denegación UNSAFE_IMPORTS (fickle.py). Debido a que estos módulos están ausentes de la lista de denegación, la función check_safety() de fickling devuelve LIKELY_SAFE con cero hallazgos para cargas útiles de pickle que invocan funciones peligrosas, incluyendo _posixsubprocess.fork_exec (generador de procesos a nivel de C capaz de ejecutar binarios arbitrarios), site.execsitecustomize (ejecuta código de personalización de sitio arbitrario) y atexit._run_exitfuncs (activa todas las devoluciones de llamada de los gestores de salida registrados). La API fickling.load() encadena check_safety() en pickle.loads() como una puerta de seguridad explícita; un veredicto LIKELY_SAFE hace que la carga útil sea deserializada y ejecutada. Esto comparte la misma causa raíz que CVE-2026-22607 (cProfile), CVE-2025-67748 (pty) y CVE-2025-67747 (marshal/types). OvertlyBadEvals no marca estos módulos porque son importaciones de la biblioteca estándar. UnsafeImports no los marca porque no están en la lista de denegación. La heurística UnusedVariables es eludida por el patrón de código de operación SETITEMS.

desc:
In multi-tenanted deployments, the application consent management mechanism fails to correctly isolate consent scopes between tenants. Consent granted by a user for a specific SaaS application within one tenant can be incorrectly applied to SaaS applications with the same name in other tenants, leading to unintended cross-tenant consent sharing.

This vulnerability may result in the exposure of user data across tenants, enabling SaaS applications in different tenants to access and modify information without explicit user authorization. This can lead to unauthorized data access and privacy violations. This vulnerability has no impact if the deployment does not support multi-tenancy.
desc_es:
En despliegues multi-inquilino, el mecanismo de gestión de consentimiento de aplicaciones no logra aislar correctamente los ámbitos de consentimiento entre inquilinos. El consentimiento otorgado por un usuario para una aplicación SaaS específica dentro de un inquilino puede aplicarse incorrectamente a aplicaciones SaaS con el mismo nombre en otros inquilinos, lo que lleva a una compartición de consentimiento trans-inquilino no intencionada.

Esta vulnerabilidad puede resultar en la exposición de datos de usuario entre inquilinos, permitiendo que las aplicaciones SaaS en diferentes inquilinos accedan y modifiquen información sin autorización explícita del usuario. Esto puede llevar a acceso no autorizado a datos y violaciones de privacidad. Esta vulnerabilidad no tiene impacto si el despliegue no soporta multi-inquilino.

desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

af_unix: Set gc_in_progress to true in unix_gc().

Igor Ushakov reported that unix_gc() could run with gc_in_progress
being false if the work is scheduled while running:

  Thread 1         Thread 2                     Thread 3
  --------         --------                     --------
                   unix_schedule_gc()           unix_schedule_gc()
                   `- if (!gc_in_progress)      `- if (!gc_in_progress)
                      |- gc_in_progress = true     |
                      `- queue_work()              |
  unix_gc() <----------------/                     |
  |                                                |- gc_in_progress = true
  ...                                              `- queue_work()
  |                                                       |
  `- gc_in_progress = false                               |
                                                          |
  unix_gc() <---------------------------------------------'
  |
  ... /* gc_in_progress == false */
  |
  `- gc_in_progress = false

unix_peek_fpl() relies on gc_in_progress not to confuse GC
by MSG_PEEK.

Let's set gc_in_progress to true in unix_gc().

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv6: account for fraggap on the paged allocation path

In __ip6_append_data(), when the paged-allocation branch is taken
(MSG_MORE / NETIF_F_SG / large fraglen), alloclen and pagedlen are
computed as

	alloclen = fragheaderlen + transhdrlen;
	pagedlen = datalen - transhdrlen;

datalen already includes fraggap (datalen = length + fraggap). When
fraggap is non-zero, this is not the first skb and transhdrlen is zero.
The fraggap bytes carried over from the previous skb are copied just past
the fragment headers in the new skb's linear area. The linear area is
therefore undersized by fraggap bytes while pagedlen is overstated by the
same amount, and the copy writes past skb->end into the trailing
skb_shared_info.

An unprivileged user can trigger this via a UDPv6 socket using
MSG_MORE together with MSG_SPLICE_PAGES.

The bad accounting was introduced by commit 773ba4fe9104 ("ipv6:
avoid partial copy for zc"). Before commit ce650a166335 ("udp6: Fix
__ip6_append_data()'s handling of MSG_SPLICE_PAGES"), the negative
copy value caused -EINVAL to be returned. That later commit allowed
MSG_SPLICE_PAGES to proceed in this case, making the corruption
triggerable.

The non-paged branch sets alloclen to fraglen, which already accounts
for fraggap because datalen does. Bring the paged branch in line by
adding fraggap to alloclen and subtracting it from pagedlen.

After this adjustment, copy no longer collapses to -fraggap on the
paged path, so remove the stale comment describing that old arithmetic.
Since a negative copy is no longer expected for a valid MSG_SPLICE_PAGES
case, remove the MSG_SPLICE_PAGES exception from the negative copy check.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: x86: Fix shadow paging use-after-free due to unexpected role

Commit 0cb2af2ea66ad ("KVM: x86: Fix shadow paging use-after-free due
to unexpected GFN") fixed a shadow paging mismatch between stored and
computed GFNs; the bug could be triggered by changing a PDE mapping from
outside the guest, and then deleting a memslot.  The rmap_remove()
call would miss entries created after the PDE change because the GFN
of the leaf SPTE does not match the GFN of the struct kvm_mmu_page.

A similar hole however remains if the modified PDE points to a non-leaf
page.  In this case the gfn can be made to match, but the role does not
match: the original large 2MB page creates a kvm_mmu_page with direct=1,
while the new 4KB needs a kvm_mmu_page with direct=0.  However,
kvm_mmu_get_child_sp() does not compare the role, and therefore reuses
the page.

The next step is installing a leaf (4KB) SPTE on the new path which
records an rmap entry under the gfn resolved by the walk.  But when
that child is zapped its parent kvm_mmu_page has direct=1 and
kvm_mmu_page_get_gfn() computes the gfn for the 4KB page as
sp->gfn + index instead of using sp->shadowed_translation[] (or sp->gfns[]
in older kernels).  It therefore fails to remove the recorded entry.

When the memslot is dropped the shadow page is freed but the rmap
entry survives, as in the scenario that was already fixed.  Code that
later walks that gfn (dirty logging, MMU notifier invalidation, and
so on) dereferences an sptep that lies in the freed page, causing the
use-after-free.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: SEV: Require in-GHCB scratch area if GHCB v2+ is in use

As per the GHCB spec, when using GHCB v2+ require the software scratch area
to reside in the GHCB's shared buffer.  Note, things like Page State Change
(PSC) requests _rely_ on this behavior, as the guest can't provide a length
when making the request, i.e. the size of the guest payload is bounded by
the size of the shared buffer.

Failure to force usage of the GHCB, and a slew of other flaws, lets a
malicious SNP guest corrupt host kernel heap memory, and leak host heap
layout information.

setup_vmgexit_scratch() allocates a buffer via kvzalloc(exit_info_2),
where exit_info_2 is guest-controlled. With exit_info_2=24, this yields
a 24-byte allocation in kmalloc-cg-32 (32-byte slab objects). The buffer
holds an 8-byte psc_hdr followed by 8-byte psc_entry structs, so only
entries[0] and entries[1] are in-bounds.

snp_begin_psc() validates end_entry against VMGEXIT_PSC_MAX_COUNT (253)
but NOT against the actual buffer size:

      idx_end = hdr->end_entry;

      if (idx_end >= VMGEXIT_PSC_MAX_COUNT) {   // checks 253, not buffer
          snp_complete_psc(svm, ...);
          return 1;
      }

      for (idx = idx_start; idx <= idx_end; idx++) {
          entry_start = entries[idx];           // OOB when idx >= 2

The guest sets end_entry=10+, causing the host to iterate entries[2+]
which are OOB into adjacent slab objects. For each OOB entry:

  - The host reads 8 bytes (OOB READ / info leak oracle)
  - If the data passes PSC validation, __snp_complete_one_psc() writes
    cur_page = 1 or 512 into the entry (OOB WRITE, sev.c:3806)
  - If validation fails, the error response reveals whether adjacent
    memory is zero vs non-zero (information disclosure to guest)

The guest controls allocation size (exit_info_2), entry range
(cur_entry/end_entry), and can fire unlimited VMGEXITs to repeatedly
hit different slab positions.

By exploiting the variety of bugs, a malicious SEV-SNP guest can:
    - OOB read adjacent kmalloc-cg-32 objects (heap layout disclosure)
    - OOB write cur_page bits into adjacent objects (heap corruption)
    - Trigger use-after-free conditions across VMGEXITs

E.g. with KASAN enabled, a single insmod of the PoC guest module
produces 73 KASAN reports:

    BUG: KASAN: slab-out-of-bounds in snp_begin_psc+0x126/0x890
    Read of size 8 at addr ffff888219ffb5e0 by task qemu-system-x86/2199

    BUG: KASAN: slab-out-of-bounds in snp_begin_psc+0x468/0x890
    Write of size 8 at addr ffff888351566648 by task qemu-system-x86/2199

    The buggy address belongs to the object at ffff888XXXXXXXXX
     which belongs to the cache kmalloc-cg-32 of size 32
    The buggy address is located N bytes to the right of
     allocated 32-byte region [ffff888XXXXXXXXX, ffff888XXXXXXXXX)

  Breakdown:
    62 slab-out-of-bounds (reads + writes past allocation)
     7 slab-use-after-free
     4 use-after-free

All credit to Stan for the wonderful description and reproducer!

desc: In nltk/nltk versions 3.9.3 and earlier, five Stanford interface classes (StanfordPOSTagger, StanfordNERTagger, StanfordParser, StanfordDependencyParser, and StanfordNeuralDependencyParser) are vulnerable to untrusted JAR code execution. These classes accept user-controllable JAR paths and execute them via the `java()` function, which invokes `subprocess.Popen()` without integrity verification. This vulnerability is identical to CVE-2026-0848, which was fixed for StanfordSegmenter by adding SHA256 verification. However, the fix was not applied to these additional classes, leaving them susceptible to arbitrary code execution when loading untrusted JAR files.

Estas clases aceptan rutas JAR controlables por el usuario y las ejecutan a través de la función ’java()’, que invoca a ’subprocess.Popen()’ sin verificación de integridad. Esta vulnerabilidad es idéntica a CVE-2026-0848, que fue corregida para StanfordSegmenter mediante la adición de verificación SHA256. Sin embargo, la corrección no se aplicó a estas clases adicionales, dejándolas susceptibles a la ejecución de código arbitrario al cargar archivos JAR no confiables.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.1 have insufficient permission checks for Composer package source links, which can expose private or internal package source information.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.1 inclusive presentan comprobaciones de permisos insuficientes para los enlaces de origen de paquetes de Composer, lo que puede exponer información de origen de paquetes privada o interna.

desc: Gitea 1.25.5 caches a branch-specific write-permission result across multiple refs in one pre-receive hook session, allowing a per-branch maintainer-edit grant to be reused for other refs and escalate to full repository write access.
desc_es: Gitea 1.25.5 almacena en caché un resultado de permiso de escritura específico de la rama a través de múltiples refs en una sesión de hook pre-recepción, permitiendo que una concesión de edición de mantenedor por rama sea reutilizada para otras refs y escale a acceso de escritura completo al repositorio.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 accept malformed or injected forwarded-proto values when detecting public URLs, allowing spoofed canonical URL generation.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 aceptan valores forwarded-proto malformados o inyectados al detectar URLs públicas, permitiendo la generación de URLs canónicas falsificadas.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.26.0 do not fail closed on bufio.Scanner errors while processing pre-receive hook input, allowing oversized input to bypass branch-protection checks.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.26.0 no fallan en modo cerrado ante errores de bufio.Scanner al procesar la entrada del hook de pre-recepción, permitiendo que una entrada sobredimensionada eluda las comprobaciones de protección de ramas.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.1 do not enforce repository-unit authorization on issue-template API endpoints.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.1 inclusive no aplican la autorización a nivel de repositorio en los puntos finales de la API de plantillas de incidencias.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.1 allow OAuth2 access token scope enforcement to be bypassed through HTTP Basic authentication.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.1 inclusive permiten que la aplicación del alcance del token de acceso OAuth2 sea eludida a través de la autenticación básica HTTP.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 use release tag names and asset names as filesystem path components when dumping release assets, allowing specially crafted names to affect dump output paths.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 utilizan nombres de etiquetas de lanzamiento y nombres de activos como componentes de ruta del sistema de archivos al volcar activos de lanzamiento, permitiendo que nombres especialmente diseñados afecten las rutas de salida del volcado.

desc: Gitea versions from 1.25.0 before 1.26.0 allow stored cross-site scripting through the extensionsRequired field in glTF files rendered by the 3D file viewer.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea desde la 1.25.0 anteriores a la 1.26.0 permiten cross-site scripting almacenado a través del campo extensionsRequired en archivos glTF renderizados por el visor de archivos 3D.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.2 allow Git LFS object reuse to authorize private source objects for users who have repository access but lack Code-unit access.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta e incluyendo la 1.26.2 permiten la reutilización de objetos Git LFS para autorizar objetos de origen privados para usuarios que tienen acceso al repositorio pero carecen de acceso a la unidad de código.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 look up tracked-time entries by time ID without scoping the lookup to the issue in the request URL, allowing deletion attempts to target entries from another issue.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 buscan entradas de tiempo registrado por ID de tiempo sin acotar la búsqueda a la incidencia en la URL de la solicitud, permitiendo que los intentos de eliminación apunten a entradas de otra incidencia.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.1 allow the Allow edits from maintainers permission path to authorize commits to repositories that the user can read but should not be able to write.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.1 inclusive permiten que la ruta de permiso ’Permitir ediciones de los mantenedores’ autorice confirmaciones a repositorios que el usuario puede leer pero en los que no debería poder escribir.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 do not consistently enforce OAuth2 authorization code expiry and single-use behavior during token exchange.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a 1.25.5 no aplican consistentemente la caducidad del código de autorización de OAuth2 y el comportamiento de uso único durante el intercambio de tokens.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 do not persist the OAuth2 PKCE S256 challenge method correctly during authorization, allowing token exchange without the expected verifier check.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 no persisten correctamente el método de desafío OAuth2 PKCE S256 durante la autorización, permitiendo el intercambio de tokens sin la verificación del verificador esperada.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 do not use the migration HTTP transport for LFS push and sync mirror operations, bypassing the configured migration transport protections for those LFS requests.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 no utilizan el transporte HTTP de migración para las operaciones de push de LFS y de espejo de sincronización, eludiendo las protecciones de transporte de migración configuradas para esas solicitudes de LFS.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 do not enforce a timeout on git grep searches, allowing expensive searches to consume server resources.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 no aplican un tiempo de espera en las búsquedas de git grep, permitiendo que búsquedas costosas consuman recursos del servidor.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 allow a user to change another user's primary email address.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 permiten a un usuario cambiar la dirección de correo electrónico principal de otro usuario.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 allow draft release data or attachments to be accessed without the required write permission.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 permiten que los datos de versiones preliminares o los adjuntos sean accedidos sin el permiso de escritura requerido.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.2 allow repository RSS and Atom feed endpoints to bypass API access token scope checks, exposing private repository commit data to tokens without the required repository scope.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.2 inclusive permiten que los puntos finales de los feeds RSS y Atom del repositorio omitan las comprobaciones de alcance de los tokens de acceso de la API, exponiendo datos de commits de repositorios privados a tokens sin el alcance de repositorio requerido.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.26.0 allow API users to fork a repository into an organization without first passing the CanCreateOrgRepo check, which can expose organization secrets.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.26.0 permiten a los usuarios de la API bifurcar un repositorio en una organización sin pasar primero la verificación CanCreateOrgRepo, lo que puede exponer secretos de la organización.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.2 have incomplete SSRF protection in webhook and migration allow-list filtering.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.2 inclusive tienen protección SSRF incompleta en el filtrado de listas de permitidos de webhooks y migración.

desc: Gitea 1.26.2 allows fork synchronization to continue after a parent repository changes from public to private, exposing data to a fork that should no longer be authorized.
desc_es: Gitea 1.26.2 permite que la sincronización de bifurcaciones continúe después de que un repositorio padre cambie de público a privado, exponiendo datos a una bifurcación que ya no debería estar autorizada.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 have insufficient permission checks for updating or rebasing pull request branches.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 tienen comprobaciones de permisos insuficientes para actualizar o rebasar ramas de solicitudes de extracción.

desc: Gitea 1.26.2 allows unauthorized users to access labels of private organizations.
desc_es: Gitea 1.26.2 permite a usuarios no autorizados acceder a etiquetas de organizaciones privadas.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 have insufficient visibility checks in organization permission APIs for hidden members and private organizations.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 tienen comprobaciones de visibilidad insuficientes en las API de permisos de organización para miembros ocultos y organizaciones privadas.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.1 do not apply public-only token filtering consistently to the user organization API, leaving an incomplete fix for CVE-2025-68941.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.26.1 inclusive no aplican el filtrado de tokens solo públicos de manera consistente a la API de organización de usuario, dejando una solución incompleta para CVE-2025-68941.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 mishandle path resolution during template repository generation, allowing template processing to read or write through symlinked or otherwise non-regular paths.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 manejan incorrectamente la resolución de rutas durante la generación de repositorios de plantilla, permitiendo que el procesamiento de plantillas lea o escriba a través de rutas con enlaces simbólicos o de otro modo no regulares.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.25.4 allow redirect bypasses through raw or percent-encoded backslashes in redirect_to values.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta la 1.25.4 inclusive permiten eludir redirecciones a través de barras invertidas sin procesar o codificadas por porcentaje en los valores de redirect_to.

desc: A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. Impacted is the function Assimp::CSMImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/CSM/CSMLoader.cpp of the component CSM File Handler. This manipulation causes heap-based buffer overflow. The attack is restricted to local execution. The exploit has been published and may be used. Patch name: eb84eec580d3f4ba2f0fd87409b7d0744620f11e. Applying a patch is the recommended action to fix this issue.
desc_es: Se ha encontrado una vulnerabilidad en Open Asset Import Library Assimp hasta la versión 6.0.5. La función afectada es Assimp::CSMImporter::InternReadFile del archivo code/AssetLib/CSM/CSMLoader.cpp del componente Gestor de Archivos CSM. Esta manipulación causa un desbordamiento de búfer basado en montículo. El ataque está restringido a la ejecución local. El exploit ha sido publicado y puede ser utilizado. Nombre del parche: eb84eec580d3f4ba2f0fd87409b7d0744620f11e. Aplicar un parche es la acción recomendada para solucionar este problema.

desc: A vulnerability has been found in DeepMyst Mysti up to 0.4.0. The affected element is the function initProjectMemory of the file src/managers/MemoryManager.ts of the component Per-Project Auto-Memory Handler. Such manipulation of the argument workspacePath leads to exposure of resource. The attack may be performed from remote. Upgrading to version 0.4.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is 6d709229b5199f6769fb3cf763e5122dcc43c079. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.
desc_es: Se ha encontrado una vulnerabilidad en DeepMyst Mysti hasta la versión 0.4.0. El elemento afectado es la función initProjectMemory del archivo src/managers/MemoryManager.ts del componente Per-Project Auto-Memory Gestor. Dicha manipulación del argumento workspacePath conduce a la exposición de recurso. El ataque puede realizarse de forma remota. Actualizar a la versión 0.4.0 es suficiente para solucionar este problema. El nombre del parche es 6d709229b5199f6769fb3cf763e5122dcc43c079. Es aconsejable actualizar el componente afectado.

desc: Gitea versions up to and including 1.26.1 allow repository archive downloads to bypass token scope checks on the web archive download endpoint.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea hasta e incluyendo la 1.26.1 permiten que las descargas de archivos de repositorio evadan las comprobaciones de alcance de token en el punto final de descarga de archivos web.

desc: Gitea versions from 1.5.0 before 1.26.3 have a TOTP single-use enforcement defect that allows a valid TOTP code to be accepted more than once across web two-factor authentication flows and the Basic Auth X-Gitea-OTP path.
desc_es: Las versiones de Gitea desde la 1.5.0 anteriores a la 1.26.3 tienen un defecto de aplicación de uso único de TOTP que permite que un código TOTP válido sea aceptado más de una vez a través de los flujos de autenticación de dos factores web y la ruta X-Gitea-OTP de autenticación básica.

desc: Gitea Docker image versions up to and including 1.26.2 use REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES=* by default, allowing any source IP to impersonate a user when reverse-proxy authentication headers such as X-WEBAUTH-USER are enabled.
desc_es: Las versiones de la imagen Docker de Gitea hasta e incluyendo la 1.26.2 usan REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES=* por defecto, permitiendo que cualquier IP de origen suplante la identidad de un usuario cuando los encabezados de autenticación de proxy inverso como X-WEBAUTH-USER están habilitados.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 have insufficient permission checks when listing tracked time entries.
desc_es: Versiones de Gitea anteriores a la 1.25.5 tienen comprobaciones de permisos insuficientes al listar las entradas de tiempo registradas.

desc: Gitea versions before 1.25.5 lack validation constraints for repository creation fields, including length-limited template fields and trust model or object format values.

desc: In PHP versions 8.2.* before 8.2.32, 8.3.* before 8.3.32, 8.4.* before 8.4.23, 8.5.* before 8.5.8, the AES-WRAP-PAD algorithm implementation in OpenSSL extension contains a buffer allocation flaw. The output buffer for the AES key-wrap-with-padding operation is sized from the plaintext length without accounting for RFC 5649 expansion. This may cause OpenSSL to write beyond allocated memory, corrupting heap metadata and triggering application abort.

desc: A vulnerability in keras-team/keras version 3.14.0 allows for arbitrary code execution due to improper handling of deserialization in the `Lambda` layer. Specifically, the `_raise_for_lambda_deserialization()` function fails to enforce the safe-mode guard when `safe_mode` is set to `None`, which is the default value when `from_config()` is called outside of a `SafeModeScope` context. This logic error conflates `None` (unset/default-deny) with `False` (explicitly disabled), bypassing the guard and allowing attacker-controlled `marshal` bytecode to be deserialized. Affected call sites include `keras.layers.deserialize(config)`, `keras.models.clone_model(model)`, and any direct invocation of `Lambda.from_config(config)` without an enclosing `SafeModeScope(True)`. This vulnerability can be exploited to achieve arbitrary OS-level code execution in the context of the server or user process.
desc_es: Una vulnerabilidad en keras-team/keras versión 3.14.0 permite la ejecución de código arbitrario debido a un manejo inadecuado de la deserialización en la capa ’Lambda’. Específicamente, la función ’_raise_for_lambda_deserialization’ no aplica la protección de modo seguro cuando ’safe_mode’ se establece en ’None’, que es el valor predeterminado cuando se llama a ’from_config()’ fuera de un contexto de ’SafeModeScope’. Este error lógico confunde ’None’ (no establecido/denegación predeterminada) con ’False’ (explícitamente deshabilitado), eludiendo la protección y permitiendo que el bytecode ’marshal’ controlado por el atacante sea deserializado. Los sitios de llamada afectados incluyen ’keras.layers.deserialize(config)’, ’keras.models.clone_model(model)’, y cualquier invocación directa de ’Lambda.from_config(config)’ sin un ’SafeModeScope(True)’ envolvente. Esta vulnerabilidad puede ser explotada para lograr la ejecución de código arbitrario a nivel del sistema operativo en el contexto del servidor o del proceso de usuario.

desc: A vulnerability was identified in RT-Thread up to 5.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function recvmsg in the library bsp/loongson/ls1cdev/libraries/ls1c_can.h of the component ls1c CAN Handler. Such manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. Local access is required to approach this attack. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Affected by this issue is the function CAN_Receive in the library bsp/synwit/libraries/SWM341_CSL/CMSIS/DeviceSupport/SWM341.h of the component SWM341 CAN Handler. Performing a manipulation results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack needs to be approached locally. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A weakness has been identified in RT-Thread up to 5.0.2. This affects the function sys_getaddrinfo of the file components/lwp/lwp_syscall.c. Executing a manipulation of the argument ai_addr can lead to memory corruption. The attack can only be executed locally. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

desc: A flaw was found in GIMP's Paint Shop Pro (PSP) file format parser. This heap buffer overflow vulnerability allows a remote attacker to cause arbitrary code execution or a denial of service (DoS) by tricking a user into opening a specially crafted PSP image file. The vulnerability occurs because the software incorrectly calculates buffer sizes when processing low bit-depth images, leading to an overwrite of adjacent memory.

desc: webpack-dev-server versions 5.2.5 and earlier terminate the whole Node.js process when an unauthenticated peer sends either a normal HTTP request with a malformed Host header or a WebSocket upgrade to the default /ws endpoint with a malformed Origin header. The malformed value causes an uncaught exception in the host-validation path and crashes the dev server. Impact is limited to availability of the development server, no data disclosure, no code execution. Patches: upgrade to webpack-dev-server 5.2.6. Workarounds: keep the dev server bound to localhost (the default) and do not expose it to untrusted networks.

webpack-dev-server versions 5.2.5 and earlier expose two internal developer endpoints, /webpack-dev-server/open-editor and /webpack-dev-server/invalidate, that perform state-changing actions on any GET request without verifying that the request originated from the dev server's own page. Any website a developer visits while the dev server is running can trigger these endpoints cross-origin with no interaction beyond the visit. An attacker can open an arbitrary existing local file in the developer's editor, including files outside the project root, and repeated requests can spawn editor processes and force recompilations that degrade the developer's machine. Patches: upgrade to webpack-dev-server 5.2.6. Workarounds: none.

A vulnerability was discovered in Keycloak's administrative interface that allows certain administrators to see information about groups they shouldn't have access to. When the new Fine-Grained Admin Permissions (FGAP v2) are turned on, an administrator who is allowed to see a specific "role" can also see a list of all groups assigned to that role. The system fails to check if the administrator has permission to see those specific groups. This could allow a restricted administrator to discover "hidden" groups and see their details, such as internal names and custom settings, which might contain sensitive deployment information.

A flaw was found in the ClientResource component of Keycloak's admin services when Fine-Grained Admin Permissions (FGAP) v2 is enabled. This issue allows a delegated administrator, who should only have limited control over specific clients, to attach or remove hidden client scopes that they are not authorized to see or manage. As a result, an attacker could inject unauthorized data or permissions into the security tokens issued to end-users, potentially tricking other applications into granting higher levels of access than intended.

A flaw was found in the Fine-Grained Admin Permissions (FGAP) v2 implementation within Keycloak's administrative services. When FGAP v2 is enabled, the system fails to properly filter child groups based on the caller's specific permissions when requested through a parent group. This allows a delegated administrator to view details of child groups they are not authorized to access directly, including group names, paths, and custom attributes.
desc_es: Se encontró una falla en la implementación de Permisos Administrativos Granulares (FGAP) v2 dentro de los servicios administrativos de Keycloak. Cuando se habilita FGAP v2, el sistema falla al filtrar correctamente los grupos secundarios basándose en los permisos específicos del solicitante cuando se solicitan a través de un grupo padre. Esto permite a un administrador delegado ver detalles de grupos secundarios a los que no está autorizado a acceder directamente, incluyendo nombres de grupo, rutas y atributos personalizados.

desc: Two off-by-one errors in the FreeIPA ipa-otpd daemon's OAuth2 device authorization handler can cause out-of-bounds memory access when processing an oversized response from a configured external OAuth2/OIDC Identity Provider. An attacker who controls or can man-in-the-middle the IdP endpoint may be able to trigger ipa-otpd to write or read one byte past the end of a fixed-size buffer. Exploitation requires FreeIPA to be configured with an external IdP, attacker control or MITM of that IdP, and a user to initiate the OAuth2 device authorization flow. The most likely impact is limited denial of service affecting the ipa-otpd daemon.

desc:
Net::IP::LPM versions before 1.11 for Perl allow a heap out-of-bounds read via an unbounded prefix length.

add() passes the prefix string to the trie builder addPrefixToTrie() without checking it against the address width.

addPrefixToTrie() then walks the prefix buffer by prefix_length bits, reading prefix[byte] for byte up to prefix_len/8, where prefix is the 4-byte (IPv4) or 16-byte (IPv6) packed address. A prefix length greater than 32 for IPv4 or 128 for IPv6, for example add("1.2.3.4/255", $v) or add("2001:db8::/255", $v), reads past the end of the packed address.

The out-of-bounds read happens during trie construction and is bounded: the prefix length is stored as an unsigned char, so the bit walk reads at most 32 bytes from the start of the packed address, a short distance past the end of the 4-byte or 16-byte buffer. It is detectable under AddressSanitizer, valgrind, or a hardened allocator, where it can abort the process. Lookups and dump() format only the valid address width, so the out-of-bounds bytes are not exposed through the module's API.
desc_es:
Las versiones de Net::IP::LPM hasta la 1.10 para Perl permiten una lectura fuera de límites en el heap a través de una longitud de prefijo no acotada.

add() pasa la cadena de prefijo al constructor de trie addPrefixToTrie() sin comprobarla contra el ancho de la dirección.

addPrefixToTrie() luego recorre el búfer de prefijo por prefix_length bits, leyendo prefix[byte] byte a byte hasta prefix_len/8, donde prefix es la dirección empaquetada de 4 bytes (IPv4) o 16 bytes (IPv6). Una longitud de prefijo mayor que 32 para IPv4 o 128 para IPv6, por ejemplo add(’1.2.3.4/255’, $v) o add(’2001:db8::/255’, $v), lee más allá del final de la dirección empaquetada.

La lectura fuera de límites ocurre durante la construcción del trie y está acotada: la longitud del prefijo se almacena como un unsigned char, por lo que el recorrido de bits lee como máximo 32 bytes desde el inicio de la dirección empaquetada, una corta distancia más allá del final del búfer de 4 o 16 bytes. Es detectable bajo AddressSanitizer, valgrind o un asignador endurecido, donde puede abortar el proceso. Las búsquedas y dump() formatean solo el ancho de dirección válido, por lo que los bytes fuera de límites no se exponen a través de la API del módulo.

desc: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (CWE-639) in CalendarDeleteEventController (app/Http/Controllers/Calendar/CalendarDeleteEventController.php), exposed at GET /calendar/event/delete/{id}, in Prospero Flow CRM before 5.5.3 allows a remote, authenticated attacker to delete arbitrary calendar events belonging to other users by manipulating the {id} path parameter, because the delete handler resolves the record with Calendar::find($id)->delete() and performs no ownership check (no user_id/company_id scoping) before deletion. This results in unauthorized destruction of other users' calendar events across the platform.
desc_es: Omisión de autorización mediante clave controlada por el usuario (CWE-639) en CalendarDeleteEventController (app/HTTP/Controllers/Calendar/CalendarDeleteEventController.php), expuesto en GET /calendar/event/delete/{id}, en Prospero Flow CRM anterior a la versión 5.5.3 permite a un atacante remoto y autenticado eliminar eventos de calendario arbitrarios pertenecientes a otros usuarios manipulando el parámetro de ruta {id}, porque el gestor de eliminación resuelve el registro con Calendar::find($id)  ->  delete() y no realiza ninguna comprobación de propiedad (sin alcance de user_id/company_id) antes de la eliminación. Esto resulta en la destrucción no autorizada de eventos de calendario de otros usuarios en toda la plataforma.

desc:
In Eclipse Theia since version 1.26.0, the backend /services/request-service RPC accepts an attacker-controlled URL from any client connected to the standard /services messaging endpoint, performs the HTTP request server-side, and returns the full response body to the caller.




Because the destination URL is neither validated nor allowlisted, a remote attacker with access to the Theia service connection can issue server-side HTTP requests to localhost or other backend-reachable hosts and read their responses, exposing internal administrative endpoints, cloud instance metadata services, and other resources that are intentionally outside the browser network boundary.




The vulnerability affects deployments where the Theia service connection is reachable by untrusted users (for example, multi-tenant or publicly-reachable Theia deployments).
desc_es:
En Eclipse Theia desde la versión 1.26.0, el RPC de backend /services/request-service acepta una URL controlada por el atacante de cualquier cliente conectado al endpoint de mensajería estándar /services, realiza la solicitud HTTP del lado del servidor y devuelve el cuerpo completo de la respuesta al llamador.

Debido a que la URL de destino no es validada ni está en una lista blanca, un atacante remoto con acceso a la conexión del servicio Theia puede emitir solicitudes HTTP del lado del servidor a localhost u otros hosts accesibles desde el backend y leer sus respuestas, exponiendo endpoints administrativos internos, servicios de metadatos de instancias en la nube y otros recursos que están intencionalmente fuera del límite de red del navegador.

La vulnerabilidad afecta a las implementaciones donde la conexión del servicio Theia es accesible por usuarios no confiables (por ejemplo, implementaciones de Theia multi-inquilino o accesibles públicamente).

desc: A vulnerability exists in the Kong Konnect Model Context Protocol (MCP) server prior to version 1.0.0, which could allow a remote attacker to perform an indirect prompt injection attack and execute unintended API requests.
desc_es: Una vulnerabilidad existe en el servidor Kong Konnect Model Context Protocol (MCP) anterior a la versión 1.0.0, lo que podría permitir a un atacante remoto realizar un ataque de inyección de ’prompt’ indirecta y ejecutar solicitudes de API no intencionadas.

desc:
In affected versions of Eclipse Theia (1.8.1 and later), the browser backend exposes privileged terminal RPC over WebSocket (/services/shell-terminal, /services/terminals/:id) without service-level authentication.




WebSocket origin validation in @theia/core is fail-open: connections are accepted when the Origin header is missing or when no THEIA_HOSTS allowlist is configured (the default). The Socket.IO integration additionally replaces the real Origin header with a client-supplied fix-origin header that an attacker can control or omit.




As a result, a foreign-origin web page visited by a user with a running Theia instance can open the /services WebSocket namespace, invoke terminal creation, attach to the resulting terminal data channel, execute arbitrary OS commands, and read their output. This affects both local developer setups (drive-by attack) and hosted or tunneled deployments without strong external authentication.




A fix is in development that enforces same-origin validation by default, removes trust in the fix-origin header, gates HTTP and WebSocket access on a SameSite=Strict; HttpOnly connection-token cookie, and sanitizes shell terminal creation options.
desc_es:
En las versiones afectadas de Eclipse Theia (1.8.1 y posteriores), el backend del navegador expone RPC de terminal privilegiado a través de WebSocket (/services/shell-terminal, /services/terminals/:id) sin autenticación a nivel de servicio.

La validación de origen de WebSocket en @theia/core es de tipo ’fail-open’: se aceptan conexiones cuando falta el encabezado Origin o cuando no hay una lista blanca THEIA_HOSTS configurada (el valor predeterminado). La integración de Socket.IO además reemplaza el encabezado Origin real con un encabezado ’fix-origin’ proporcionado por el cliente que un atacante puede controlar u omitir.

Como resultado, una página web de origen externo visitada por un usuario con una instancia de Theia en ejecución puede abrir el espacio de nombres WebSocket /services, invocar la creación de terminales, adjuntarse al canal de datos del terminal resultante, ejecutar comandos arbitrarios del sistema operativo y leer su salida. Esto afecta tanto a las configuraciones de desarrollador locales (ataque de paso) como a las implementaciones alojadas o tunelizadas sin una autenticación externa fuerte.

Se está desarrollando una solución que aplica la validación de mismo origen por defecto, elimina la confianza en el encabezado ’fix-origin’, restringe el acceso HTTP y WebSocket mediante una cookie de token de conexión SameSite=Strict; HttpOnly, y sanea las opciones de creación de terminales de shell.

desc: The RTMKit (rometheme-for-elementor) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in versions up to, and including, 2.0.7 This is due to insufficient path validation on the 'template' parameter in the render_templates AJAX endpoint, which is used directly in a require/include statement without sanitization. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to include and execute files on the server ending in _templates.php, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files.

Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in Raera - Ankara Web Design and Digital Advertising Agency Destekz allows SQL Injection.

This issue affects Destekz: through 02062026. NOTE: The vendor was contacted and it was learned that the product is not supported.
desc_es:
La vulnerabilidad de neutralización incorrecta de elementos especiales utilizados en un comando SQL (’inyección SQL’) en Raera - Ankara Web Design and Digital Advertising Agency Destekz permite la inyección SQL.

Este problema afecta a Destekz: hasta el 02062026. NOTA: Se contactó al proveedor y se supo que el producto no es compatible.

desc:
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in Raera - Ankara Web Design and Digital Advertising Agency Destekz allows Reflected XSS.

This issue affects Destekz: through 02062026. NOTE: The vendor was contacted and it was learned that the product is not supported.
desc_es:
Neutralización incorrecta de la entrada durante la generación de páginas web (’cross-site scripting’) vulnerabilidad en Raera - Ankara Web Design and Digital Advertising Agency Destekz permite XSS Reflejado.

Este problema afecta a Destekz: hasta el 02062026. NOTA: Se contactó al proveedor y se supo que el producto no tiene soporte.

desc:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Apache Lucene.Net (Lucene.Net.Replicator library).

This issue affects Apache Lucene.Net.Replicator: from 4.8.0-beta00005 through 4.8.0-beta00017.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.8.0-beta00018, which fixes the issue.
desc_es:
Limitación inadecuada de un nombre de ruta a un directorio restringido (’Salto de ruta’) vulnerabilidad en Apache Lucene.Net (biblioteca Lucene.Net.Replicator).

Este problema afecta a Apache Lucene.Net.Replicator: desde la 4.8.0-beta00005 hasta la 4.8.0-beta00017.

Se recomienda a los usuarios actualizar a la versión 4.8.0-beta00018, que corrige el problema.

desc: The Zakra theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via post meta values in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0. This is due to the theme registering three post meta fields (zakra_menu_item_color, zakra_menu_item_hover_color, and zakra_menu_item_active_color) with 'show_in_rest' => true and 'auth_callback' => '__return_true', but without any sanitize_callback parameter in the register_post_meta() calls. While the classic editor save path applies sanitize_hex_color() sanitization, the REST API path completely bypasses this protection. The unsanitized meta values are then retrieved via get_post_meta() and concatenated directly into CSS strings that are output through wp_add_inline_style() without any escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses the injected page.
desc_es: El tema Zakra para WordPress es vulnerable a cross-site scripting almacenado a través de valores meta de publicación en todas las versiones hasta, e incluyendo, la 4.2.0. Esto se debe a que el tema registra tres campos meta de publicación (zakra_menu_item_color, zakra_menu_item_hover_color y zakra_menu_item_active_color) con ’show_in_rest’ => true y ’auth_callback’ => ’__return_true’, pero sin ningún parámetro sanitize_callback en las llamadas a register_post_meta(). Mientras que la ruta de guardado del editor clásico aplica la sanitización sanitize_hex_color(), la ruta de la API REST omite completamente esta protección. Los valores meta no sanitizados son luego recuperados a través de get_post_meta() y concatenados directamente en cadenas CSS que se emiten a través de wp_add_inline_style() sin ningún escape. Esto hace posible que atacantes autenticados, con acceso de nivel Colaborador y superior, inyecten scripts web arbitrarios en páginas que se ejecutarán cada vez que un usuario acceda a la página inyectada.

desc: The GenerateBlocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Headline Block 'linkMetaFieldType' Dynamic Link Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A contributor-level attacker can store a JavaScript payload in their own profile description (allowlisted by get_safe_user_meta_keys()) and prepend 'javascript:' via the linkMetaFieldType attribute, creating a fully attacker-controlled href that executes when any user, including an administrator, clicks the rendered headline link.

The LatePoint – Calendar Booking Plugin for Appointments and Events plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.6.1. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to modify the personally identifiable information (first name, last name, phone number, and notes) of any existing customer record, including those linked to administrator accounts, by submitting the booking form with a known customer's email address. Exploitation requires the plugin to be configured with guest bookings enabled (is_customer_auth_disabled() returning true), which is necessary for the vulnerable unauthenticated code path in process_step_customer() to be reached.

The The CURCY – Multi Currency for WooCommerce – Smoothly on WooCommerce 9.x plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary shortcode execution in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.14. This is due to the software allowing users to execute an action that does not properly validate a value before running do_shortcode. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shortcodes.

The Ad Inserter – Ad Manager & AdSense Ads plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to and including 2.8.16 via the 'data' attribute of the [adinserter] shortcode. This is due to the replace_ai_tags() function processing a {reusable-block-N} tag pattern that calls get_post_field('post_content', N) without verifying the requesting user's capability with current_user_can('read_post'), without restricting the post type to 'wp_block', and without checking the post status. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to read the full content of arbitrary posts including Private, Draft, Pending, Trashed, and password-protected posts owned by other users, by placing the shortcode in a post they own and previewing it.

Dell Client Platform BIOS contains an Authentication Bypass by Primary Weakness vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with physical access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information Disclosure.

The RTMKit plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the Advanced Heading widget's 'Background Text' parameter in versions up to, and including, 2.0.7 This is due to insufficient output escaping on the 'background_text_heading' setting in the render() function, which concatenates the value directly into an HTML attribute without applying esc_attr(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

Puppet resource_api (shipped in Puppet Core 8.x and Puppet Enterprise 2023.8.x and 2025.x) does not preserve the sensitive flag on parameters defined via the resource-api, causing values such as passwords to be stored in cleartext in the agent's local transaction state cache. Affected versions of the resource_api module include all versions between 1.5.0 - 1.9.1 and 2.0.0 The issue was fixed in puppet resource_api 1.9.2 and 2.0.1 released with Puppet Core 8.20.0 and PE 2023.8.10 & PE 2025.11.0.

The Comments – wpDiscuz plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the guest commenter 'Website' field in versions up to, and including, 7.6.56 This is due to insufficient output escaping in the getCommentAuthor() function, which interpolates the stored comment_author_url value directly into single-quoted HTML attributes without applying esc_url() or esc_attr(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) – Easy Quiz and Survey Maker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 11.1.4. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to modify quizzes they do not own, overwrite quiz results pages, and reroute quiz-result notification emails to attacker-controlled addresses. An attacker first calls the /quiz/structure endpoint with an arbitrary victim quiz ID to obtain a valid nonce bound to that quiz ID and their own user ID, then presents that nonce to the /quizzes/{id}/emails save endpoint, which accepts it without verifying quiz ownership.

A flaw was found in HPLIP (HP Linux Imaging and Printing Software). This vulnerability, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-8631, may allow a remote attacker to escalate privileges or achieve arbitrary code execution. This can occur through an integer overflow in the hpcups processing path when handling specially crafted print data.

Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Apache Lucene.Net (Lucene.Net.Replicator library).

This issue affects Apache Lucene.Net.Replicator: from 4.8.0-beta00005 before 4.8.0-beta00018.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.8.0-beta00018, which fixes the issue.
desc_es:
Vulnerabilidad de limitación incorrecta de un nombre de ruta a un directorio restringido (’Salto de ruta’) en Apache Lucene.Net (biblioteca Lucene.Net.Replicator).

Este problema afecta a Apache Lucene.Net.Replicator: desde 4.8.0-beta00005 antes de 4.8.0-beta00018.

Se recomienda a los usuarios actualizar a la versión 4.8.0-beta00018, que corrige el problema.

Vulnerabilidad de Restricción Inadecuada de Referencia a Entidad Externa XML en Apache Lucene.Net (biblioteca Lucene.Net.Analysis.Common).
